 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_complete_selection_v1(p_offer uuid,p_target uuid) RETURNS uuid[] LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '''' AS $function$
DECLARE picked uuid[]:=''{}'';g record;q record;group_ids uuid[]:=''{}'';needed integer;iterations integer:=0;changed boolean;target_found boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MG_SERVICE_REQUIRED'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.offers o WHERE o.id=p_offer AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action''
   AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco'')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.input_fields f WHERE f.offer_id=p_offer AND f.required)
  OR (SELECT count(*)FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups WHERE offer_id=p_offer)>32 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 LOOP
  changed:=false;iterations:=iterations+1;IF iterations>32 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  FOR g IN SELECT * FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups x WHERE x.offer_id=p_offer AND NOT x.id=ANY(group_ids)
   AND (x.depends_on IS NULL OR x.depends_on=ANY(picked)) ORDER BY x.id LOOP
   needed:=g.min_selected;IF needed<0 OR needed>g.max_selected OR needed>8 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
   IF g.purpose=''target'' THEN
    IF needed<>1 OR g.max_selected<1 OR p_target IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
    SELECT * INTO q FROM combat_panel_private.choice_options x WHERE x.group_id=g.id AND x.offer_id=p_offer
      AND x.source_payload->>''target_actor_id''=p_target::text ORDER BY x.id LIMIT 1;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;picked:=array_append(picked,q.id);target_found:=true;
   ELSIF g.purpose=''movement_distance'' THEN
    IF needed>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
    IF needed=1 THEN
      SELECT * INTO q FROM combat_panel_private.choice_options x WHERE x.group_id=g.id AND x.offer_id=p_offer
       ORDER BY CASE WHEN x.source_payload=''{}''::jsonb THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, x.distance_m NULLS FIRST,x.id LIMIT 1;
      IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;picked:=array_append(picked,q.id);
    END IF;
   ELSE
    -- Special native groups require a strategy of their own; never invent choices or inputs.
    IF needed>0 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
   END IF;
   group_ids:=array_append(group_ids,g.id);changed:=true;
  END LOOP;
  EXIT WHEN NOT changed;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT target_found THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- Native choice_commit validates these exact IDs under its authentic commit permit.
 RETURN picked;
END
$function$;
ALTER FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_complete_selection_v1(uuid,uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_complete_selection_v1(uuid,uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_complete_selection_v1(uuid,uuid) TO service_role;
';
 IF (to_regprocedure('mission_generic_owner.native_entry_action_v1(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb)') IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NATIVE_INTENT_NEW_HELPER_ABSENT' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_entry_action_v1(p_batch uuid,p_encounter uuid,p_round uuid,p_slot jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '''' AS $function$
DECLARE b mission_generic_owner.unified_batches;writer mission_generic_owner.work_items;e mission_generic_owner.encounters;
 c mission_generic_owner.panel_choices;cw mission_generic_owner.work_items;ofr combat_panel_private.offers;
 d public.combat_v2_declarations;candidate record;move record;pc record;target record;
 actor uuid;target_id uuid;location uuid;actor_name text;target_name text;ord integer;attempt text;resolution text;
 status jsonb;selected uuid[];cmd jsonb;res jsonb;att jsonb;work_result jsonb;movement jsonb:=NULL;attack_found boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MG_SERVICE_REQUIRED'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches WHERE id=p_batch FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT writer FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=b.writer_work_id;
 IF mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(writer.id) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR b.retired_at IS NOT NULL OR b.encounter_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_encounter OR b.next_round_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_round
  OR writer.state<>''provider_started'' OR b.payload IS DISTINCT FROM writer.payload OR b.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM writer.payload_sha256
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_publication_permits x WHERE x.batch_id=b.id AND x.work_id=writer.id AND x.transaction_id=txid_current() AND x.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid())
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.payload->''offense_slots'') x WHERE x=p_slot)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_ENTRY_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM mission_generic_owner.encounters WHERE encounter_id=p_encounter AND master_session_id=b.master_session_id;
 SELECT (x->>''actor_id'')::uuid INTO STRICT actor FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.actor_map) x WHERE x->>''actor_key''=p_slot->>''actor_key'';
 SELECT q.ord::integer INTO STRICT ord FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.payload->''offense_slots'') WITH ORDINALITY q(x,ord) WHERE q.x=p_slot;
 SELECT location_id INTO STRICT location FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=b.master_session_id;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw WHERE rw.round_id=p_round AND rw.batch_id=b.id AND rw.publication_id IS NULL AND actor=ANY(rw.expected_actor_ids))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_ENTRY_ACTOR'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
 LOOP
  status:=mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(b.master_session_id,p_encounter,actor);
  SELECT * INTO STRICT cw FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=(status->>''work_id'')::uuid AND kind=''choice'' AND state=''ready'' AND master_session_id=b.master_session_id;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM mission_generic_owner.panel_choices WHERE work_id=cw.id AND actor_id=actor AND encounter_id=p_encounter AND consumed_at IS NULL;
  IF c.options_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(c.legal_options) OR c.legal_options#>>''{context,round_id}'' IS DISTINCT FROM p_round::text
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_CATALOG_BINDING'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';END IF;
  SELECT x->>''display_name'' INTO actor_name FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''actors'') x WHERE x->>''actor_id''=actor::text;
  actor_name:=CASE ord WHEN 1 THEN ''Il primo avversario'' WHEN 2 THEN ''Il secondo avversario'' ELSE ''L''''avversario numero ''||ord END||CASE WHEN nullif(btrim(actor_name),'''')IS NULL THEN '''' ELSE '' (''||actor_name||'')'' END;
  selected:=NULL;target_id:=NULL;ofr.id:=NULL;attack_found:=false;
  IF movement IS NULL THEN
   -- An offer is already issued by the approved native ability producer. No model numeric values or free inputs are supplied.
   FOR candidate IN SELECT o.* FROM combat_panel_private.offers o WHERE o.actor_id=actor AND o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered''
    AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco''
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''offers'') x WHERE x->>''offer_id''=o.id::text)
    ORDER BY o.id LOOP
    FOR target IN SELECT a.id FROM public.combat_v2_actors a WHERE a.session_id=p_encounter AND a.actor_kind=''pg'' AND a.state=''attivo'' AND a.companion_id IS NULL
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.choice_options q JOIN combat_panel_private.choice_groups g ON g.id=q.group_id
       WHERE q.offer_id=candidate.id AND g.purpose=''target'' AND q.source_payload->>''target_actor_id''=a.id::text) ORDER BY a.id LOOP
      selected:=mission_generic_owner.native_complete_selection_v1(candidate.id,target.id);
      IF selected IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT * INTO STRICT ofr FROM combat_panel_private.offers WHERE id=candidate.id;attack_found:=true;target_id:=target.id;EXIT;END IF;
    END LOOP;
    EXIT WHEN attack_found;
   END LOOP;
  END IF;
  IF attack_found THEN
   resolution:=''attack'';SELECT x->>''display_name'' INTO target_name FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''actors'') x WHERE x->>''actor_id''=target_id::text;
   IF nullif(btrim(target_name),'''') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_TARGET_LABEL'';END IF;
   attempt:=actor_name||'' tenta un attacco contro ''||target_name||''.'';
  ELSE
   IF movement IS NULL THEN
    -- Select only an existing directional movement capability which improves approach to at least one opposing PG.
    SELECT o.id offer_id,q.id option_id,g.depends_on direction_id,cap.capability_id,cap.end_x_m,cap.end_y_m,
      combat_spatial.distance_m(cap.start_x_m,cap.start_y_m,cap.end_x_m,cap.end_y_m) travel
     INTO move FROM combat_panel_private.offers o JOIN combat_panel_private.choice_groups g ON g.offer_id=o.id AND g.purpose=''movement_distance'' AND g.depends_on IS NOT NULL
     JOIN combat_panel_private.choice_options q ON q.group_id=g.id AND q.offer_id=o.id
     JOIN combat_spatial.movement_capabilities cap ON cap.capability_id=nullif(q.source_payload->>''movement_capability_id'','''')::uuid AND cap.actor_id=actor AND cap.state=''offered''
     JOIN combat_spatial.arena_instances ai ON ai.instance_id=cap.instance_id AND ai.encounter_id=p_encounter AND ai.state=''open''
     JOIN combat_spatial.actor_states body ON body.instance_id=ai.instance_id AND body.actor_id=actor AND body.state=''active''
     JOIN LATERAL(SELECT min(combat_spatial.distance_m(cap.start_x_m,cap.start_y_m,t.x_m,t.y_m)) start_nearest,
       min(combat_spatial.distance_m(cap.end_x_m,cap.end_y_m,t.x_m,t.y_m)) end_nearest
       FROM combat_spatial.actor_states t JOIN public.combat_v2_actors pg ON pg.id=t.actor_id AND pg.actor_kind=''pg'' AND pg.state=''attivo''
       WHERE t.instance_id=ai.instance_id AND t.state=''active'') distances ON distances.end_nearest<distances.start_nearest
     WHERE o.actor_id=actor AND o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''control''
      AND o.source_payload=''{"adapter":"master_v2","dispatch":"master_movement_control"}''::jsonb
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''offers'') x WHERE x->>''offer_id''=o.id::text)
      AND (cap.start_x_m,cap.start_y_m)=(body.x_m,body.y_m) AND cap.actor_body_version=body.body_version AND cap.map_version=ai.map_version
     ORDER BY distances.end_nearest,travel,o.id,q.id LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN
     SELECT * INTO STRICT ofr FROM combat_panel_private.offers WHERE id=move.offer_id;selected:=ARRAY[move.direction_id,move.option_id];resolution:=''movement_control'';attempt:='''';
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF ofr.id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO ofr FROM combat_panel_private.offers o WHERE o.actor_id=actor AND o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered''
     AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''passa''
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''offers'') x WHERE x->>''offer_id''=o.id::text)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.input_fields f WHERE f.offer_id=o.id AND f.required)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g WHERE g.offer_id=o.id AND g.min_selected>0) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 1;
    IF ofr.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_NATIVE_WAIT_NOT_OFFERED'' USING ERRCODE=''55000'';END IF;
    selected:=''{}''::uuid[];resolution:=CASE WHEN movement IS NULL THEN ''unresolved'' ELSE ''movement'' END;
    attempt:=actor_name||CASE WHEN movement IS NULL THEN '' accenna l''''avvicinamento, senza riuscire a portare il colpo.'' ELSE '' si porta verso gli avversari; il colpo resta da portare.'' END;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  IF length(attempt)>320 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_ATTEMPT_TEXT_LONG'';END IF;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.work_items SET state=''provider_started'' WHERE id=cw.id AND state=''ready'' AND dispatch_receipt_id IS NULL AND authorization_id IS NULL AND dispatch_id IS NULL AND lease_id IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_SYNTHETIC_WORK_STATE'';END IF;
  cmd:=jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''combat-panel-command/1'',''request_key'',c.request_key,''location_id'',location,''activity_id'',p_encounter,''context_version'',c.context_version,
    ''offer_id'',ofr.id,''selected_option_ids'',to_jsonb(selected),''inputs'',''[]''::jsonb,''narrative_text'',attempt);
  res:=mission_generic_owner.choice_commit(cw.id,c.id,cmd);
  IF resolution=''movement_control'' THEN
   IF res#>>''{receipt,declaration_id}'' IS NOT NULL OR res#>>''{receipt,operation}'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''control''
    OR res#>>''{receipt,values_written}'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''false'' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clan_marionettisti_private.movement_receipts x
      WHERE x.request_key=c.request_key AND x.round_id=p_round AND x.owner_actor_id=actor AND x.body_actor_id=actor AND x.capability_id=move.capability_id AND x.distance_m>0)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_NATIVE_MOVEMENT_RECEIPT'';END IF;
   movement:=jsonb_build_object(''choice_work_id'',cw.id,''panel_choice_id'',c.id,''request_key'',c.request_key,''native_receipt_id'',res#>''{receipt,receipt_id}'',
     ''native_result_sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(res),''capability_id'',move.capability_id);
   work_result:=jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-generic-choice-synthetic/2'',''slot_id'',p_slot->>''slot_id'',''resolution_kind'',''movement_control'',
     ''command'',combat_panel_private.validate_command(cmd),''native'',res,''movement'',movement);
  ELSE
   SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM public.combat_v2_declarations WHERE id=(res#>>''{receipt,declaration_id}'')::uuid AND round_id=p_round AND actor_id=actor
    AND kind=CASE WHEN resolution=''attack'' THEN ''attacco'' ELSE ''passa'' END AND declaration_text=attempt AND request_key=c.request_key;
   IF (resolution=''attack'' AND d.target_actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM target_id) OR (resolution<>''attack'' AND d.target_actor_id IS NOT NULL)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_DECLARATION_BINDING'';END IF;
   att:=mission_generic_owner.attest_deferred_png_v4(d.id,cw.id,res);
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_consumer_private.declaration_messages dm WHERE dm.declaration_id=d.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_MINI_FATO_FORBIDDEN'';END IF;
   work_result:=jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-generic-choice-synthetic/2'',''slot_id'',p_slot->>''slot_id'',''resolution_kind'',resolution,
      ''command'',combat_panel_private.validate_command(cmd),''native'',res,''declaration_id'',d.id,''attestation'',att,''movement'',movement);
  END IF;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.work_items SET state=''completed'',result=work_result,result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(work_result),receipt_id=(res#>>''{receipt,receipt_id}'')::uuid,finalized_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE id=cw.id AND state=''provider_started'' AND finalized_at IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_SYNTHETIC_WORK_FINALIZE'';END IF;
  EXIT WHEN resolution<>''movement_control'';
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(''slot_id'',p_slot->>''slot_id'',''actor_key'',p_slot->>''actor_key'',''actor_id'',actor,''resolution_kind'',resolution,
  ''target_actor_id'',d.target_actor_id,''choice_work_id'',cw.id,''offer_id'',ofr.id,''selected_option_ids'',to_jsonb(selected),''attempt_text'',attempt,''declaration_id'',d.id,
  ''native_receipt_id'',att->''native_receipt_id'',''native_result_sha256'',att->''native_result_sha256'',''movement'',movement);
END

$function$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_entry_action_v1(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb) TO service_role;
';
 IF (to_regprocedure('mission_generic_owner.native_intent_policy_v1(uuid)') IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NATIVE_INTENT_NEW_HELPER_ABSENT' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_intent_policy_v1(p_session uuid) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '''' AS $function$
DECLARE cfg jsonb;r mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service() THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton;
 IF r.state IS DISTINCT FROM ''enabled'' OR r.revision_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM r.observed_revision_sha256
  OR r.revision_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(r.canonical_preimage,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex'') THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 cfg:=r.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>''{config,c1266_native_intent_resolution}'';
 IF cfg->>''schema_version'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''mission-native-intent-resolution-policy/1'' OR cfg->>''enabled'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''true''
  OR cfg->>''master_session_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM p_session::text OR cfg->>''ordinary_public_enabled'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''false''
  OR cfg->>''future_feature'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''native_intent_resolution_v1''
  OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(p_session) IS NULL
  OR mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(p_session,false,true) IS NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=m.location_id
   WHERE m.id=p_session AND m.closed_at IS NULL AND m.owner_kind=''ai_service'' AND l.is_test AND l.is_active
    AND l.id=''0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b''::uuid) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 RETURN cfg;
END
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_intent_policy_v1(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_intent_policy_v1(uuid) TO service_role;
';
 IF (to_regprocedure('mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(uuid)') IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NATIVE_INTENT_NEW_HELPER_ABSENT' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(p_work uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '''' AS $function$
DECLARE w mission_generic_owner.work_items;cfg jsonb;sb jsonb;wc mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1;terminal boolean:=false;original boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service() THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 IF w.id IS NULL OR w.kind<>''narration'' OR w.payload->>''schema_version''<>''mission-generic-narration/4''
  OR w.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 cfg:=mission_generic_owner.native_intent_policy_v1(w.master_session_id);IF cfg IS NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO wc FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 WHERE work_id=w.id;
 IF wc.contract_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract) OR wc.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload_sha256
  OR wc.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id OR wc.scope IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 PERFORM mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(w.id);
 IF (wc.contract->''features''?''native_intent_resolution_v1'') IS TRUE
  AND ((wc.contract->''features''?''role_intents_v1'') OR (wc.contract->''features''?''role_intents_v2'')) IS TRUE
  AND (wc.contract->''features''?''free_narrative_v1'') IS TRUE
  AND (wc.contract->''features''?''provider_output_retention_v1'') IS TRUE THEN RETURN true;END IF;
 sb:=cfg->''saved_writer'';
 original:=w.result_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM sb->>''result_sha256'' AND public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM sb->>''result_jsonb_sha256''
  AND w.message_id IS NULL AND w.state IN(''failed'',''provider_started'');
 terminal:=w.state=''completed'' AND w.message_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 sp
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.id=sp.batch_id AND b.id::text=sb->>''batch_id'' AND b.writer_work_id=w.id AND b.state=''published'' AND b.message_id=w.message_id
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=b.source_window_id AND sw.consumed_message_id=w.message_id
  JOIN public.messages m ON m.id=w.message_id AND m.kind=''fato'' AND m.recipient_user IS NULL AND m.character_id IS NULL
  WHERE sp.work_id=w.id AND sp.message_id=w.message_id AND sp.source_revision=sb->>''source_revision'' AND sp.raw_result_sha256=sb->>''result_sha256''
   AND sp.final_text_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(m.body,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex''));
 IF w.id::text IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''work_id'' OR w.master_session_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''master_session_id''
  OR w.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''payload_sha256'' OR (original IS DISTINCT FROM true AND terminal IS DISTINCT FROM true)
  OR w.result->>''raw_sha256'' IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''raw_sha256''
  OR w.receipt_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''receipt_id'' OR w.dispatch_receipt_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''dispatch_receipt_id''
  OR w.authorization_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''authorization_id'' OR w.dispatch_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''dispatch_id''
  OR w.request_key::text IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''request_key'' OR w.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''definition_sha256''
  OR w.run_control_version::text IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''run_control_version'' OR w.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''step_key''
  OR w.payload->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''source_revision''
  OR (terminal IS DISTINCT FROM true AND w.payload->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(w.master_session_id))
  OR wc.contract_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''contract_sha256'' OR wc.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM sb->>''source_release_sha256''
  OR w.result->>''ok'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''true'' OR w.result->>''provider_calls'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''1''
  OR w.result->>''outcome_uncertain'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''false''
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b WHERE b.id::text=sb->>''batch_id'' AND b.writer_work_id=w.id
   AND b.source_window_id::text=sb->>''source_window_id'' AND b.decision_work_id::text=sb->>''decision_work_id''
   AND b.decision_sha256=sb->>''decision_sha256'' AND (b.message_id IS NULL OR(terminal IS TRUE AND b.message_id=w.message_id)) AND b.retired_at IS NULL)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_outputs_v1 o WHERE o.id::text=sb->>''output_receipt_id''
   AND o.work_id=w.id AND o.authorization_id=w.authorization_id AND o.dispatch_id=w.dispatch_id AND o.dispatch_receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND o.raw_sha256=sb->>''raw_sha256'' AND o.raw_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(o.raw_output,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex''))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d
   JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit fa ON fa.receipt_id=d.id AND fa.event_code=''generic_finalized''
   JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls q ON q.producer=''mission_generic_ai'' AND q.source_id=d.id AND q.scope_id=w.master_session_id AND q.call_no=1
    AND q.state=''settled'' AND q.charged_usd=d.charged_cost_usd
   WHERE d.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND d.authority_receipt_id=w.id AND d.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND d.request_key=w.request_key
    AND d.status=''success'' AND d.dispatch_count=1 AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    AND fa.details->>''work_id''=w.id::text AND fa.details->>''result_sha256''=sb->>''result_sha256''
    AND fa.details->>''result_jsonb_sha256''=sb->>''result_jsonb_sha256'' AND fa.details->>''outcome_uncertain''=''false'')
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 RETURN true;
END
$function$;
ALTER FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(uuid) TO service_role;
';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION combat_panel_private.commit_master_actor(p_command jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
DECLARE p jsonb; uid uuid:=exam_regia_private.current_principal(); key uuid; fp text; receipt_id uuid:=gen_random_uuid();
 prior combat_panel_private.request_receipts%ROWTYPE; o combat_panel_private.offers%ROWTYPE;
 c combat_panel_private.contexts%ROWTYPE; a public.combat_v2_actors%ROWTYPE;
 env jsonb; resolved jsonb; selected uuid[]; payload jsonb; intent jsonb; result jsonb; receipt jsonb;
 targets uuid[]:=''{}''; coverages uuid[]:=''{}''; primary_attack uuid; movement uuid; substitution uuid;
  rotation_radius integer; fireball_selection jsonb; declaration uuid; label text; target_label text; event jsonb; dispatch text; flow_allocations jsonb:=''[]'';
  human_stage boolean:=false;intent_stage boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 IF uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_authentication_required'' USING ERRCODE=''28000''; END IF;
 p:=combat_panel_private.validate_command(p_command); key:=(p->>''request_key'')::uuid; fp:=public.combat_v2_sha256(p);
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(''panel-request:''||uid::text||'':''||key::text,731));
 SELECT * INTO prior FROM combat_panel_private.request_receipts WHERE principal_user=uid AND request_key=key;
 IF prior.request_key IS NOT NULL THEN
   IF prior.command_fingerprint<>fp THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_request_key_conflict'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
   RETURN jsonb_set(prior.viewer_envelope,''{receipt,replayed}'',''true'',false);
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO o FROM combat_panel_private.offers WHERE id=(p->>''offer_id'')::uuid AND principal_user=uid;
 IF o.id IS NULL OR o.source_payload->>''adapter'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''master_v2''
   OR o.kind NOT IN (''action'',''defense'') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_offer_not_available'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 -- Preserve historical idempotent receipts; reject only new commits of stale passive attacks.
 IF o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco''
   AND o.source_payload->>''ability_source''=''clan''
   AND o.source_payload->>''ability_id''=''4056f62d-77f3-47f9-8ecb-9a7799682a9d'' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_passive_ability_not_attack'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM combat_panel_private.contexts WHERE id=o.context_id AND principal_user=uid;
 IF c.activity_kind<>''master_v2'' OR c.round_id IS NULL
   OR c.location_id IS DISTINCT FROM (p->>''location_id'')::uuid OR c.activity_id IS DISTINCT FROM (p->>''activity_id'')::uuid THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_activity_scope_invalid'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 PERFORM public.combat_v2_lock_round(c.round_id);
 env:=combat_panel_private.master_projection(c.location_id,c.command_actor_id);
 PERFORM 1 FROM combat_panel_private.contexts WHERE id=c.id FOR UPDATE;
 c:=combat_panel_private.owned_context(c.id,(p->>''context_version'')::bigint);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM combat_panel_private.offers WHERE id=o.id FOR UPDATE;
 IF o.state<>''offered'' OR o.context_version<>c.context_version OR o.source_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.source_fingerprint
   OR o.scene_version IS DISTINCT FROM c.scene_version OR o.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.command_actor_id THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_offer_not_available'' USING ERRCODE=''40001''; END IF;
 IF o.requires_role AND length(btrim(p->>''narrative_text''))=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_role_required'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM public.combat_v2_actors WHERE id=o.actor_id AND session_id=c.activity_id
   AND exam_regia_private.actor_principal(id,controller_user)=uid AND companion_id IS NULL AND state=''attivo'' FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(value::uuid),''{}'') INTO selected FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p->''selected_option_ids'');
 resolved:=combat_panel_private.resolve_selections(o.id,selected,p->''inputs'');
 FOR payload IN SELECT choice->''payload'' FROM jsonb_array_elements(resolved->''groups'') AS groups(g)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g->''options'') AS choices(choice) LOOP
   IF payload ? ''rotation_radius_m'' THEN
     IF rotation_radius IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''rotation_selection_duplicate'';END IF;
     rotation_radius:=(payload->>''rotation_radius_m'')::integer;
   END IF;
   IF payload ? ''fireball_selection'' THEN
     IF fireball_selection IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''fireball_selection_conflict'';END IF;
     fireball_selection:=payload->''fireball_selection'';
   END IF;
   IF payload ? ''attack_target_id'' THEN
     coverages:=array_append(coverages,(payload->>''attack_target_id'')::uuid);
     primary_attack:=coalesce(primary_attack,(payload->>''attack_declaration_id'')::uuid);
   ELSIF payload ? ''target_actor_id'' THEN targets:=array_append(targets,(payload->>''target_actor_id'')::uuid);
   END IF;
   IF o.source_payload#>>''{sabaku_flow,version}''=''sabaku-flow/2'' AND payload ? ''target_actor_id'' THEN
     IF NOT payload ? ''flow_count'' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''sabaku_flow_quantity_required'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
     flow_allocations:=flow_allocations||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
       ''target_actor_id'',payload->''target_actor_id'',''flows'',payload->''flow_count''));
   END IF;
   IF payload ? ''movement_capability_id'' THEN
     IF movement IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_movement_selection_conflict'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
     movement:=(payload->>''movement_capability_id'')::uuid;
   END IF;
   IF payload ? ''substitution_option_id'' THEN
     IF substitution IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_substitution_selection_conflict'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
     substitution:=(payload->>''substitution_option_id'')::uuid;
   END IF;
  END LOOP;
  -- Only the Master-controlled PNG may stage privately. PG declarations and
  -- defenses continue through the published window and native controller checks.
  IF a.actor_kind=''png'' THEN
   PERFORM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_stage_permit_v1(c.round_id,a.id,key);
  END IF;
  -- The human permit is bound to this offer, actor and request in the same TX.
  -- Native context/offer and controller versions were checked above under lock.
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1
    FROM mission_generic_owner.regia_human_stage_permits_v1 hp
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.regia_human_windows_v1 hw
      ON hw.next_round_id=hp.round_id AND hw.master_session_id=hp.master_session_id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw
      ON uw.round_id=hp.round_id AND uw.batch_id=hw.batch_id
       AND uw.master_session_id=hw.master_session_id
    JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=c.activity_id
       AND cs.master_session_id=hw.master_session_id
    JOIN public.master_v2_sessions ms ON ms.id=hw.master_session_id
    WHERE hp.round_id=c.round_id AND hp.actor_id=a.id AND hp.request_key=key
      AND hp.principal_id=uid AND hp.transaction_id=txid_current()
      AND hp.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
      AND hw.encounter_id=cs.id AND a.session_id=cs.id AND a.actor_kind=''png''
      AND ms.owner_kind=''human'' AND ms.closed_at IS NULL
      AND ms.master_user=uid
      AND ms.location_id=''0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b''::uuid
      AND ((hw.state=''private'' AND hw.side=''png'' AND uw.side=''png''
            AND uw.publication_id IS NULL AND o.operation=''declare''
            AND a.id=ANY(uw.expected_actor_ids))
        OR (hw.state=''published'' AND hw.side=''pg'' AND uw.side=''pg''
            AND uw.publication_id IS NOT NULL AND o.operation=''defend''
            AND o.kind=''defense'')))
    INTO human_stage;
  intent_stage:=auth.uid() IS NULL AND public.combat_v2_is_service() AND a.actor_kind=''png''
   AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.operation=''declare'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''passa''
   AND mission_generic_owner.unified_service_staging(c.round_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.id=uw.batch_id JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_publication_permits pp ON pp.batch_id=b.id AND pp.work_id=b.writer_work_id
     WHERE uw.round_id=c.round_id AND uw.publication_id IS NULL AND a.id=ANY(uw.expected_actor_ids) AND b.retired_at IS NULL
       AND pp.transaction_id=txid_current() AND pp.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() AND mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(b.writer_work_id));
  PERFORM mission_generic_owner.unified_assert_command(c.round_id,CASE WHEN o.kind=''defense'' THEN ''defend'' ELSE ''declare'' END);
 dispatch:=o.source_payload->>''dispatch'';
 IF dispatch IN (''action'',''movement'') THEN
   IF o.source_payload->>''fireball''=''true'' THEN
     IF fireball_selection IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''fireball_selection_required'';END IF;
     intent:=clan_uchiha_private.fireball_prepare(c.round_id,a.id,key,fireball_selection);
     SELECT coalesce(array_agg(value::uuid),''{}'') INTO targets FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(intent->''target_actor_ids'',''[]''));
   ELSE
   intent:=jsonb_build_object(''kind'',o.source_payload->''kind'');
   IF intent->>''kind''=''attacco'' THEN
     IF cardinality(targets)=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_target_required'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
     intent:=intent||jsonb_build_object(''target_actor'',targets[1],''target_actor_ids'',targets,
       ''ability_source'',o.source_payload->''ability_source'');
     IF o.source_payload ? ''ability_id'' THEN intent:=intent||jsonb_build_object(''ability_id'',o.source_payload->''ability_id''); END IF;
   ELSIF intent->>''kind''=''utilita'' AND o.source_payload->>''aburame_escape''=''true'' THEN
     intent:=intent||jsonb_build_object(''ability_source'',''clan'',''ability_id'',''f5e9af24-70f1-49f6-a7ca-74f59256336e'');
   ELSIF dispatch=''movement'' THEN
     IF movement IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_movement_required'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
   END IF;
   IF movement IS NOT NULL THEN
     IF dispatch=''movement'' THEN
       PERFORM combat_panel_private.prepare_master_movement(c.round_id,a.id,movement,key);
     ELSIF dispatch=''action'' AND intent->>''kind''=''attacco'' AND cardinality(targets)=1
       AND (coalesce(intent->>''ability_source'',''mano'')=''mano'' OR (intent->>''ability_source''=''clan'' AND intent->>''ability_id'' IN (''9ac77d79-9894-5388-9753-70538ac5eaa3'',''b076a976-c75b-4b5a-8813-b0e8e2c3af03'')))
       AND combat_panel_private.movement_attack_target_valid(a.id,targets[1],movement,CASE WHEN intent->>''ability_source''=''clan'' THEN 2 ELSE combat_panel_private.manual_contact_center_range(a.id,targets[1]) END)
       AND (intent->>''ability_source''<>''clan'' OR intent->>''ability_id''=''b076a976-c75b-4b5a-8813-b0e8e2c3af03'' OR (SELECT combat_spatial.distance_m(start_x_m,start_y_m,end_x_m,end_y_m)>=5 FROM combat_spatial.movement_capabilities WHERE capability_id=movement)) THEN
       PERFORM combat_panel_private.prepare_master_movement(c.round_id,a.id,movement,key);
     ELSE
       RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_movement_attack_selection_invalid'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
     END IF;
   END IF;
   END IF;
   IF intent->>''kind''=''attacco'' AND fireball_selection IS NULL THEN
     PERFORM combat_panel_private.multiplication_prepare_selected_aims(c.round_id,a.id,key,targets,resolved);
   END IF;
   IF o.source_payload#>>''{sabaku_flow,version}''=''sabaku-flow/2'' THEN
     IF movement IS NOT NULL OR dispatch<>''action'' OR intent->>''kind''<>''attacco'' THEN
       RAISE EXCEPTION ''sabaku_flow_offer_invalid'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
     -- Il totale e'' congelato nell''offerta nativa, mai ricevuto come valore libero dal client.
     IF jsonb_typeof(o.source_payload#>''{sabaku_flow,quantity}'') IS DISTINCT FROM ''number''
       OR (o.source_payload#>>''{sabaku_flow,quantity}'') !~ ''^[1-3]$'' THEN
       RAISE EXCEPTION ''sabaku_flow_total_required'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
     IF (clan_sabaku_private.flow_costs(1,flow_allocations)->>''flows'')::integer
       IS DISTINCT FROM (o.source_payload#>>''{sabaku_flow,quantity}'')::integer THEN
       RAISE EXCEPTION ''sabaku_flow_total_allocation_mismatch'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
     PERFORM clan_sabaku_private.flow_prepare(c.round_id,a.id,key,o.id,''panel'',flow_allocations);
   END IF;
   IF intent->>''ability_source''=''clan'' AND combat_v2_elemental_internal.suiton_profile(a.id,(intent->>''ability_id'')::uuid) IS NOT NULL THEN
     PERFORM combat_v2_elemental_internal.suiton_prepare_callback(''master_v2'',o.id,a.id,key,
       ARRAY(SELECT value::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p->''selected_option_ids'')),p->''inputs'',intent);
   END IF;
   IF intent->>''ability_source''=''clan'' AND combat_v2_elemental_internal.other_profile(a.id,(intent->>''ability_id'')::uuid) IS NOT NULL THEN
     PERFORM combat_v2_elemental_internal.other_prepare_callback(''master_v2'',o.id,a.id,key,ARRAY(SELECT value::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p->''selected_option_ids'')),p->''inputs'',intent);
   END IF;
   result:=public.combat_v2_action_declare(c.round_id,a.id,intent,p->>''narrative_text'',key);
   declaration:=(result#>>''{data,declaration_id}'')::uuid;
 ELSIF dispatch=''defense'' THEN
   IF cardinality(coverages)=0 OR primary_attack IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_coverage_required'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
   intent:=jsonb_build_object(''reaction'',o.source_payload->''reaction'',''attack_target_ids'',coverages);
   IF o.source_payload ? ''ability_id'' THEN intent:=intent||jsonb_build_object(
     ''ability_source'',o.source_payload->''ability_source'',''ability_id'',o.source_payload->''ability_id''); END IF;
   IF o.source_payload->>''rotation_version''=''hyuga-rotation/1'' THEN
     PERFORM clan_hyuga_private.rotation_prepare(c.round_id,a.id,primary_attack,key,rotation_radius);
   END IF;
   IF o.source_payload->>''aburame_clone''=''aburame-clone/1'' THEN
     IF primary_attack IS DISTINCT FROM (o.source_payload->>''attack_id'')::uuid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''aburame_clone_attack_drift'';END IF;
     PERFORM clan_aburame_private.clone_prepare(c.round_id,a.id,primary_attack,key,(o.source_payload->>''movement_capability'')::uuid);
   END IF;
   result:=public.combat_v2_defense_declare(c.round_id,primary_attack,a.id,intent,p->>''narrative_text'',key);
   declaration:=(result#>>''{data,defense_id}'')::uuid;
 ELSIF dispatch=''substitution'' THEN
   IF substitution IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_substitution_required'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
   PERFORM clan_marionettisti_private.assert_jutsu_source(a.id,''jutsu'',''31b15861-fb78-4f8a-ac1c-ebf2d957c32e'');
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_spatial.request_receipts WHERE request_key=key) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_request_key_conflict'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
   result:=public.combat_v2_substitution_select_v1(substitution,key);
   declaration:=(result->>''defense_declaration_id'')::uuid;
   -- Il selector vivo crea il testo vuoto. Completa solo la dichiarazione
   -- appena creata, ancora inviata e controllata, nella stessa transazione.
   UPDATE public.combat_v2_declarations SET declaration_text=p->>''narrative_text''
     WHERE id=declaration AND round_id=c.round_id AND actor_id=a.id AND request_key=key
       AND controller_user_snapshot=uid AND state=''inviata'' AND declaration_text='''';
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_substitution_declaration_invalid'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_dispatch_not_available'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 IF declaration IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''panel_source_receipt_invalid'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
  IF o.operation=''defend'' THEN
    PERFORM combat_panel_private.multiplication_register_defense_selections(c.round_id,a.id,key,resolved,declaration); END IF;
  IF a.actor_kind=''png'' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw WHERE uw.round_id=c.round_id) THEN
     IF NOT (mission_generic_owner.unified_service_staging(c.round_id) OR human_stage)
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MUF_STAGING_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
    UPDATE public.combat_v2_declarations d SET controller_user_snapshot=uid
    FROM public.combat_v2_provider_instances_v1 pi
    WHERE d.id=declaration AND d.round_id=c.round_id AND d.actor_id=a.id AND d.request_key=key
       AND (d.state=''inviata'' OR ((human_stage OR(intent_stage AND d.kind=''passa'' AND result#>>''{data,declaration_id}''=d.id::text AND result#>>''{data,phase}''=''risolto'' AND result#>''{data,auto_resolution}'' IS NOT NULL AND result#>''{data,auto_resolution}''<>''null''::jsonb)) AND d.state=''risolta''
         AND d.kind IN(''utilita'',''movimento'',''passa'',''difesa'',''nessuna'')))
       AND d.declaration_text=coalesce(p->>''narrative_text'','''')
      AND d.controller_version_snapshot=a.controller_version
      AND pi.id=a.provider_instance_v1_id AND pi.session_id=a.session_id
      AND d.controller_user_snapshot=pi.narrative_version_ref;
    IF NOT FOUND AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations d
      WHERE d.id=declaration AND d.round_id=c.round_id AND d.actor_id=a.id AND d.request_key=key
        AND d.state IN (''inviata'',''risolta'') AND d.declaration_text=coalesce(p->>''narrative_text'','''')
        AND d.controller_version_snapshot=a.controller_version AND d.controller_user_snapshot=uid)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MG_DECLARATION_AUTHORITY_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
  END IF;
  -- Solo Passa nativo senza role: l''offerta effettiva è attestata prima del publisher
 -- nella stessa TX. La receipt finale segue normalmente; ogni errore annulla tutto.
 IF a.actor_kind=''png'' AND NOT o.requires_role AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.operation=''declare''
   AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''passa'' AND intent->>''kind''=''passa''
    AND nullif(btrim(p->>''narrative_text''),'''') IS NULL
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows uw WHERE uw.round_id=c.round_id) THEN
    IF NOT (mission_generic_owner.unified_service_staging(c.round_id) OR human_stage) OR NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations pd WHERE pd.id=declaration AND pd.round_id=c.round_id
       AND pd.actor_id=a.id AND pd.request_key=key AND pd.kind=''passa''
       AND (pd.state=''inviata'' OR (pd.state=''risolta'' AND human_stage
          AND result#>>''{data,declaration_id}''=pd.id::text
          AND result#>>''{data,phase}''=''risolto''
          AND result#>''{data,auto_resolution}'' IS NOT NULL
          AND result#>''{data,auto_resolution}''<>''null''::jsonb))
       AND pd.controller_user_snapshot=uid AND pd.controller_version_snapshot=a.controller_version
       AND pd.declaration_text=coalesce(p->>''narrative_text'','''')) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION ''MUF_ROLELESS_PASS_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
   UPDATE combat_panel_private.offers SET state=''consumed'',consumed_request_key=key
     WHERE id=o.id AND principal_user=uid AND context_id=c.id AND actor_id=a.id AND state=''offered'';
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MUF_ROLELESS_PASS_OFFER'' USING ERRCODE=''40001''; END IF;
 END IF;
 PERFORM combat_panel_private.publish_master_declaration(declaration,p->>''narrative_text'');
 SELECT value->>''display_name'' INTO label FROM jsonb_array_elements(env->''actors'') WHERE value->>''actor_id''=a.id::text;
 IF cardinality(targets)>0 THEN
   SELECT value->>''display_name'' INTO target_label FROM jsonb_array_elements(env->''actors'') WHERE value->>''actor_id''=targets[1]::text;
 END IF;
 event:=jsonb_build_object(''event_id'',receipt_id,''event_kind'',''action_declared'',''actor_id'',a.id,''display_name'',label,
   ''label_version'',c.context_version,''target_actor_id'',CASE WHEN target_label IS NOT NULL THEN targets[1] END,
   ''target_display_name'',target_label,''target_label_version'',CASE WHEN target_label IS NOT NULL THEN c.context_version END,
   ''summary'',CASE WHEN o.operation=''defend'' THEN ''Difesa registrata'' ELSE ''Azione registrata'' END);
 env:=combat_panel_private.master_projection(c.location_id,a.id);
 receipt:=jsonb_build_object(''receipt_id'',receipt_id,''request_key'',key,''operation'',o.operation,''replayed'',false,
   ''activity_id'',c.activity_id,''round_id'',c.round_id,''context_version_before'',o.context_version,
   ''context_version_after'',env#>''{context,version}'',''declaration_id'',declaration,''report_id'',NULL,
   ''values_written'',false,''display_events'',jsonb_build_array(event));
 env:=jsonb_set(env,''{receipt}'',receipt);
 UPDATE combat_panel_private.offers SET state=''consumed'',consumed_request_key=key WHERE id=o.id;
 INSERT INTO combat_panel_private.request_receipts(principal_user,request_key,command_fingerprint,offer_id,event_id,viewer_envelope)
   VALUES(uid,key,fp,o.id,receipt_id,env);
 RETURN env;
END $function$

';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.attest_deferred_png_v4(p_declaration uuid, p_choice_work uuid, p_result jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
DECLARE x mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4; pc mission_generic_owner.panel_choices;
        rr combat_panel_private.request_receipts; offer combat_panel_private.offers;
        native_sha text;adaptive boolean;native_kind text;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SERVICE_ONLY'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT x FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4
   WHERE declaration_id=p_declaration AND choice_work_id=p_choice_work FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_publication_permits permit
   WHERE permit.batch_id=x.batch_id AND permit.transaction_id=txid_current()
     AND permit.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_PERMIT_MISSING'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT pc FROM mission_generic_owner.panel_choices WHERE id=x.panel_choice_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT rr FROM combat_panel_private.request_receipts
   WHERE request_key=x.panel_request_key AND principal_user=pc.principal_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT offer FROM combat_panel_private.offers WHERE id=rr.offer_id;
 native_sha:=public.combat_v2_sha256(p_result);
 SELECT mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(b.writer_work_id),d.kind INTO STRICT adaptive,native_kind FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b JOIN public.combat_v2_declarations d ON d.id=x.declaration_id WHERE b.id=x.batch_id;
 IF pc.work_id<>p_choice_work OR pc.consumed_at IS NULL OR pc.result IS DISTINCT FROM p_result
   OR rr.viewer_envelope IS DISTINCT FROM p_result OR rr.request_key<>x.panel_request_key
   OR offer.actor_id<>x.actor_id OR offer.kind<>''action''
   OR offer.source_payload->>''dispatch''<>''action'' OR (offer.source_payload->>''kind'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''attacco'' AND NOT(adaptive IS TRUE AND native_kind=''passa'' AND offer.source_payload->>''kind'' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ''passa''))
   OR p_result#>>''{receipt,declaration_id}'' IS DISTINCT FROM x.declaration_id::text
   OR p_result#>>''{receipt,request_key}'' IS DISTINCT FROM x.panel_request_key::text
   OR p_result#>>''{receipt,round_id}'' IS DISTINCT FROM x.round_id::text
   OR p_result#>>''{receipt,replayed}'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''false''
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_NATIVE_RECEIPT_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 IF x.attested_at IS NOT NULL THEN
   IF x.native_offer_id IS DISTINCT FROM offer.id OR x.native_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM (p_result#>>''{receipt,receipt_id}'')::uuid
      OR x.native_result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM native_sha THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_ATTEST_REPLAY_CONFLICT''; END IF;
 ELSE
   UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4
      SET native_offer_id=offer.id,native_receipt_id=(p_result#>>''{receipt,receipt_id}'')::uuid,
          native_result_sha256=native_sha,attested_at=clock_timestamp()
      WHERE declaration_id=x.declaration_id AND attested_at IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_ATTEST_RACE''; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(''declaration_id'',x.declaration_id,''actor_id'',x.actor_id,
  ''slot_id'',x.slot_id,''attempt_sha256'',x.attempt_sha256,
  ''native_receipt_id'',(p_result#>>''{receipt,receipt_id}'')::uuid,''native_result_sha256'',native_sha);
END $function$

';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.choice_commit(p_work uuid, p_capability uuid, p_command jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
declare c mission_generic_owner.panel_choices%rowtype; a public.combat_v2_actors%rowtype;
 cmd jsonb; fp text; o combat_panel_private.offers%rowtype; permit uuid; res jsonb;
 e mission_generic_owner.encounters%rowtype; actor_key text; entry_policy jsonb; initial_offense boolean;
begin
 if auth.uid() is not null or not public.combat_v2_is_service() then raise exception ''MG_SERVICE_REQUIRED'' using errcode=''42501''; end if;
 select * into strict c from mission_generic_owner.panel_choices where id=p_capability and work_id=p_work for update;
 cmd:=combat_panel_private.validate_command(p_command);fp:=public.combat_v2_sha256(cmd);
 if c.consumed_at is not null then
  if c.command_sha256 is distinct from fp then raise exception ''MG_COMMAND_REPLAY_CONFLICT'' using errcode=''22023''; end if;
  return c.result;
 end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(c.master_session_id);
 perform mission_generic_owner.unified_choice_assert(p_work);
 select * into strict a from public.combat_v2_actors where id=c.actor_id and session_id=c.encounter_id for update;
 if c.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() or a.controller_version<>c.controller_version or a.state<>''attivo''
  or c.principal_id is distinct from mission_generic_owner.actor_principal(a.id)
  or c.options_sha256 is distinct from public.combat_v2_sha256(c.legal_options)
  or c.request_key is distinct from (cmd->>''request_key'')::uuid
  or c.encounter_id is distinct from (cmd->>''activity_id'')::uuid
  or c.context_version is distinct from (cmd->>''context_version'')::bigint
  or cmd->>''location_id'' is distinct from c.legal_options#>>''{context,location_id}''
 then raise exception ''MG_CHOICE_STALE'' using errcode=''40001''; end if;
 select * into strict o from combat_panel_private.offers where id=(cmd->>''offer_id'')::uuid
  and principal_user=c.principal_id and actor_id=c.actor_id and state=''offered'';
 if o.kind=''administration'' or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''offers'') x where x->>''offer_id''=o.id::text)
 then raise exception ''MG_COMMAND_FORBIDDEN'' using errcode=''42501''; end if;
 select * into strict e from mission_generic_owner.encounters where encounter_id=c.encounter_id and master_session_id=c.master_session_id;
 select map_actor->>''actor_key'' into strict actor_key from jsonb_array_elements(e.actor_map) map_actor where map_actor->>''actor_id''=c.actor_id::text;
 select scene_actor->''entry_policy'' into entry_policy from jsonb_array_elements(mission_generic_owner.scene(c.master_session_id,e.step_key)->''actors'') scene_actor
   where scene_actor->>''actor_key''=actor_key;
 if entry_policy is not null and entry_policy->>''offense_allowed''=''false''
   and not (o.kind=''defense'' or (o.kind=''action'' and o.source_payload->>''kind'' in(''passa'',''utilita'',''movimento'')))
 then raise exception ''MNE_PASSIVE_OFFENSE_FORBIDDEN'' using errcode=''42501'';end if;
 select exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows ur join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.id=ur.batch_id
   where ur.round_id=(c.legal_options#>>''{context,round_id}'')::uuid and ub.source_window_id is not null
     and ub.composition_kind=''entry_png'' and ub.decision->>''schema_version''=''mission-director-proposal/2''
     and mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(ub.writer_work_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true
     and actor_key=any(ub.selected_actor_keys)) into initial_offense;
 if initial_offense and not (o.kind=''action'' and o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco'')
 then raise exception ''MNE_ENTRY_OFFENSE_REQUIRED'' using errcode=''42501'';end if;
 insert into mission_generic_owner.panel_permits(master_session_id,encounter_id,actor_id,work_id,principal_id,operation,request_key,transaction_id,backend_pid)
 values(c.master_session_id,c.encounter_id,c.actor_id,p_work,c.principal_id,''commit'',c.request_key,txid_current(),pg_backend_pid()) returning id into permit;
 res:=case when o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''multiplication'' then combat_panel_private.commit_multiplication(cmd)
  when o.source_payload=''{"adapter":"master_v2","dispatch":"master_movement_control"}''::jsonb then combat_panel_private.commit_master_movement_control(jsonb_set(cmd,''{narrative_text}'',to_jsonb(''''::text),false))
  else combat_panel_private.commit_master_actor(cmd) end;
 update mission_generic_owner.panel_permits set consumed_at=clock_timestamp() where id=permit;
 update mission_generic_owner.panel_choices set consumed_at=clock_timestamp(),command_sha256=fp,result=res where id=c.id;
 return res;
end $function$

';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.choice_options(p_session uuid, p_actor uuid, p_work uuid, p_request uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
declare a public.combat_v2_actors%rowtype; e mission_generic_owner.encounters%rowtype;
 c mission_generic_owner.panel_choices%rowtype; m public.master_v2_sessions%rowtype;
 env jsonb; permit uuid; principal uuid; persona jsonb;director jsonb;phase_actor jsonb;actor_key text;entry_policy jsonb;initial_offense boolean;
begin
 if auth.uid() is not null or not public.combat_v2_is_service() or p_work is null or p_request is null
 then raise exception ''MG_SERVICE_REQUIRED'' using errcode=''42501''; end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(p_session);
 select * into strict m from public.master_v2_sessions where id=p_session for update;
 select * into c from mission_generic_owner.panel_choices where work_id=p_work for update;
 if found then
  if c.master_session_id<>p_session or c.actor_id<>p_actor or c.request_key<>p_request or c.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  then raise exception ''MG_CHOICE_STALE'' using errcode=''40001''; end if;
 else
  select * into strict a from public.combat_v2_actors where id=p_actor and actor_kind=''png''
   and controller_user is null and character_id is null and companion_id is null and state=''attivo'' for update;
  select * into strict e from mission_generic_owner.encounters where encounter_id=a.session_id and master_session_id=p_session;
  principal:=mission_generic_owner.actor_principal(p_actor);
  if principal is null then raise exception ''MG_ACTOR_NOT_BOUND'' using errcode=''42501''; end if;
  insert into mission_generic_owner.panel_permits(master_session_id,encounter_id,actor_id,work_id,principal_id,operation,request_key,transaction_id,backend_pid)
  values(p_session,e.encounter_id,p_actor,p_work,principal,''options'',p_request,txid_current(),pg_backend_pid()) returning id into permit;
  env:=combat_panel_private.master_projection(m.location_id,p_actor);
  env:=combat_panel_private.master_options(m.location_id,p_actor,(env#>>''{context,version}'')::bigint);
  if env->>''status'' is distinct from ''ready'' or env#>>''{context,activity_id}'' is distinct from e.encounter_id::text
   or env#>>''{viewer,command_actor_id}'' is distinct from p_actor::text
   or env#>>''{viewer,can_command}'' is distinct from ''true''
  then raise exception ''MG_CHOICE_NOT_READY'' using errcode=''55000''; end if;
  select map_actor->>''actor_key'' into strict actor_key from jsonb_array_elements(e.actor_map) map_actor where map_actor->>''actor_id''=p_actor::text;
  select scene_actor->''entry_policy'' into entry_policy from jsonb_array_elements(mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,e.step_key)->''actors'') scene_actor
    where scene_actor->>''actor_key''=actor_key;
  select exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows ur join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.id=ur.batch_id
    where ur.round_id=(env#>>''{context,round_id}'')::uuid and ub.source_window_id is not null
      and ub.composition_kind=''entry_png'' and ub.decision->>''schema_version''=''mission-director-proposal/2''
     and mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(ub.writer_work_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true
      and actor_key=any(ub.selected_actor_keys)) into initial_offense;
  -- Administration belongs to the supervising staff, never to the AI actor.
  env:=jsonb_set(env,''{offers}'',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x order by ord)
   from jsonb_array_elements(env->''offers'') with ordinality q(x,ord)
   where x->>''kind''<>''administration''),''[]''::jsonb),false);
  if entry_policy is not null and entry_policy->>''offense_allowed''=''false'' then
   env:=jsonb_set(env,''{offers}'',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(offer order by ord)
     from jsonb_array_elements(env->''offers'') with ordinality offered(offer,ord)
     join combat_panel_private.offers native_offer on native_offer.id=(offer->>''offer_id'')::uuid
     where native_offer.kind=''defense'' or (native_offer.kind=''action'' and native_offer.source_payload->>''kind'' in(''passa'',''utilita'',''movimento''))),''[]''::jsonb),false);
  end if;
  if initial_offense then
   env:=jsonb_set(env,''{offers}'',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(offer order by ord)
     from jsonb_array_elements(env->''offers'') with ordinality offered(offer,ord)
     join combat_panel_private.offers native_offer on native_offer.id=(offer->>''offer_id'')::uuid
     where native_offer.kind=''action'' and native_offer.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco''),''[]''::jsonb),false);
  end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(env->''offers'')=0
  then raise exception ''MG_CHOICE_NOT_READY'' using errcode=''55000''; end if;
  if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(env->''offers'') x where x->>''kind''=''administration'')
  then raise exception ''MG_ADMIN_OFFER_FORBIDDEN'' using errcode=''42501''; end if;
  insert into mission_generic_owner.panel_choices(work_id,master_session_id,encounter_id,actor_id,principal_id,request_key,
   context_version,controller_version,legal_options,options_sha256,expires_at)
  values(p_work,p_session,e.encounter_id,p_actor,principal,p_request,(env#>>''{context,version}'')::bigint,
   a.controller_version,env,public.combat_v2_sha256(env),clock_timestamp()+case when mission_academy_owner.staff_carrier_runtime(p_session) then interval ''3 hours'' else interval ''150 seconds'' end) returning * into c;
  update mission_generic_owner.panel_permits set consumed_at=clock_timestamp() where id=permit;
 end if;
 -- Identity/persona are taken from the approved provider version, not model output.
 select jsonb_build_object(''identity'',nv.skeleton->''identity'',''voice'',nv.skeleton->''voice'',
  ''conduct'',nv.skeleton->''conduct'',''goals'',nv.skeleton->''goals'',''motivations'',nv.skeleton->''motivations'',
  ''knowledge_limits'',nv.skeleton->''knowledge_limits'',''knowledge_boundary'',nv.knowledge_boundary,
  ''life_core'',jsonb_build_object(
    ''background'',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(''role'',nv.skeleton#>''{identity,role}'',''origin'',nv.skeleton#>''{identity,origin}'')),
    ''motivations'',nv.skeleton->''motivations'',''goals'',nv.skeleton->''goals'',''fears'',nv.skeleton->''fears'',
    ''fragility'',nv.skeleton->''fragility'',''resilience'',nv.skeleton->''resilience'',
    ''character_errors'',nv.skeleton->''character_errors'',''recovery'',nv.skeleton->''recovery'',
    ''relationships'',nv.skeleton->''relationships'',
    ''continuity'',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(''emotional'',nv.skeleton#>''{continuity,emotional}'',
      ''relational'',nv.skeleton#>''{continuity,relational}'',''emotional_endings'',nv.skeleton#>''{continuity,emotional_endings}'')))) || case when mission_academy_owner.staff_carrier_runtime(p_session) then jsonb_build_object(''forbidden'',nv.skeleton->''forbidden'') else ''{}''::jsonb end into persona
 from public.combat_v2_actors aa join public.combat_v2_provider_instances_v1 pi on pi.id=aa.provider_instance_v1_id
 join public.nb_template_versions nv on nv.id=pi.narrative_version_ref where aa.id=c.actor_id;
 select * into strict e from mission_generic_owner.encounters
  where encounter_id=c.encounter_id and master_session_id=p_session;
 director:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(p_session,e.step_key);
 if director is not null then
  select x->>''actor_key'' into strict actor_key from jsonb_array_elements(e.actor_map) x
   where x->>''actor_id''=c.actor_id::text;
  select x into phase_actor from jsonb_array_elements(director->''actors'') x where x->>''actor_key''=actor_key;
  -- Project only this actor''s phase notes. Never pass the director plot,
  -- consequences, other actors or their knowledge to the decision worker.
  persona:=persona||jsonb_build_object(''phase_context'',jsonb_build_object(
   ''schema_version'',''mission-actor-phase-context/1'',''actor_id'',c.actor_id,''actor_key'',actor_key,
   ''role_in_phase'',coalesce(phase_actor->>''role_in_phase'',''''),
   ''goal_private'',coalesce(phase_actor->>''goal_private'',''''),
   ''known_facts_private'',coalesce(phase_actor->>''known_facts_private'','''')));
 end if;
 persona:=persona||jsonb_build_object(''scene_intent'',(select ni->>''intent'' from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows ur join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.id=ur.batch_id cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(ub.decision->''npc_intents'',''[]''::jsonb)) ni join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.actor_map) am on am->>''actor_key''=ni->>''actor_key'' where ur.round_id=(c.legal_options#>>''{context,round_id}'')::uuid and am->>''actor_id''=c.actor_id::text));
 return jsonb_build_object(''capability_id'',c.id,''actor_id'',c.actor_id,''legal_options'',c.legal_options,
  ''context_version'',c.context_version,''request_key'',c.request_key,''persona'',persona,
  ''encounter_id'',c.encounter_id,''authority_receipt_id'',c.id,
  ''authorized_context'',mission_generic_owner.unified_choice_pin(c.id,mission_generic_owner.choice_public_context(p_session,c.actor_id,(c.legal_options#>>''{context,round_id}'')::uuid,c.legal_options))); 
end $function$

';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.seal_deferred_png_v4(p_batch uuid, p_message uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
DECLARE b mission_generic_owner.unified_batches; m public.messages; row record;
        slot_count integer; receipt_count integer:=0; prev_pos integer:=0; pos integer;
        msg_sha text; receipts jsonb:=''[]''::jsonb;adaptive boolean;cw mission_generic_owner.work_items;mw mission_generic_owner.work_items;mov jsonb;resolution text;native_kind text;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SERVICE_ONLY'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches WHERE id=p_batch;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_publication_permits permit
  WHERE permit.batch_id=b.id AND permit.work_id=b.writer_work_id
    AND permit.transaction_id=txid_current() AND permit.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid())
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_PERMIT_MISSING'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT m FROM public.messages WHERE id=p_message;
 IF b.payload->>''schema_version''<>''mission-generic-narration/4'' OR b.composition_kind<>''entry_png''
   OR jsonb_typeof(b.payload->''offense_slots'')<>''array''
   OR m.location_id IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT location_id FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=b.master_session_id)
   OR m.kind<>''fato'' OR m.character_id IS NOT NULL OR m.recipient_user IS NOT NULL
   OR nullif(btrim(m.body),'''') IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEAL_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 adaptive:=mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(b.writer_work_id);
 slot_count:=jsonb_array_length(b.payload->''offense_slots'');
 IF slot_count=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEAL_EMPTY_COHORT''; END IF;
 msg_sha:=public._combat_narrative_sha(m.id);
 FOR row IN SELECT x.*,slot->>''slot_id'' expected_slot,slot->>''actor_key'' expected_actor
   FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4 x
   JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(b.payload->''offense_slots'') WITH ORDINALITY AS slots(slot,ord)
     ON ord=x.slot_order
   WHERE x.batch_id=b.id ORDER BY x.slot_order FOR UPDATE OF x LOOP
   IF row.slot_id IS DISTINCT FROM row.expected_slot OR row.actor_key IS DISTINCT FROM row.expected_actor
     OR row.slot_id IS DISTINCT FROM row.actor_key
     OR row.source_window_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_window_id
     OR row.attested_at IS NULL OR row.sealed_at IS NOT NULL
     OR row.attempt_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(row.attempt_text,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex'')
     OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw
       JOIN public.combat_v2_declarations d ON d.round_id=rw.round_id
       WHERE rw.batch_id=b.id AND rw.round_id=row.round_id AND rw.side=''png''
         AND d.id=row.declaration_id AND d.actor_id=row.actor_id AND (d.kind=''attacco'' OR(adaptive IS TRUE AND d.kind=''passa'' AND d.target_actor_id IS NULL))
         AND ((d.kind=''attacco'' AND d.target_actor_id IS NOT NULL) OR(adaptive IS TRUE AND d.kind=''passa'' AND d.target_actor_id IS NULL)) AND d.declaration_text=row.attempt_text)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEAL_RECEIPT_INVALID''; END IF;
   IF adaptive THEN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT cw FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=row.choice_work_id AND master_session_id=b.master_session_id AND kind=''choice'' AND state=''completed'';
    SELECT kind INTO STRICT native_kind FROM public.combat_v2_declarations WHERE id=row.declaration_id;
    resolution:=cw.result->>''resolution_kind'';mov:=cw.result->''movement'';
    IF cw.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(cw.result) OR cw.result->>''schema_version'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''mission-generic-choice-synthetic/2''
     OR cw.result->>''slot_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM row.slot_id OR cw.result->>''declaration_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM row.declaration_id::text
     OR resolution IS NULL OR resolution NOT IN(''attack'',''movement'',''unresolved'')
     OR (resolution=''attack'' AND(native_kind<>''attacco'' OR mov IS DISTINCT FROM ''null''::jsonb))
     OR (resolution<>''attack'' AND native_kind<>''passa'')
     OR public.combat_v2_sha256(cw.result->''native'') IS DISTINCT FROM row.native_result_sha256
     OR (resolution=''unresolved'' AND mov IS DISTINCT FROM ''null''::jsonb)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_RESOLUTION_SEAL'';END IF;
    IF resolution=''movement'' THEN
     SELECT * INTO STRICT mw FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=(mov->>''choice_work_id'')::uuid AND master_session_id=b.master_session_id AND encounter_id=b.encounter_id AND kind=''choice'' AND state=''completed'';
     IF mw.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(mw.result) OR mw.result->>''schema_version'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''mission-generic-choice-synthetic/2''
      OR mw.result->>''resolution_kind'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''movement_control'' OR mw.result->''movement'' IS DISTINCT FROM mov
      OR mw.result->>''slot_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM row.slot_id OR public.combat_v2_sha256(mw.result->''native'') IS DISTINCT FROM mov->>''native_result_sha256''
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pc JOIN combat_panel_private.request_receipts rr ON rr.request_key=pc.request_key AND rr.principal_user=pc.principal_id
       JOIN clan_marionettisti_private.movement_receipts mr ON mr.request_key=pc.request_key AND mr.round_id=row.round_id AND mr.owner_actor_id=row.actor_id AND mr.body_actor_id=row.actor_id
       WHERE pc.id=(mov->>''panel_choice_id'')::uuid AND pc.work_id=mw.id AND pc.actor_id=row.actor_id AND pc.encounter_id=b.encounter_id
        AND pc.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND pc.result IS NOT DISTINCT FROM mw.result->''native'' AND rr.viewer_envelope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM pc.result
        AND rr.event_id=(mov->>''native_receipt_id'')::uuid AND mr.capability_id=(mov->>''capability_id'')::uuid AND mr.distance_m>0)
     THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_MOVEMENT_SEAL'';END IF;
    END IF;
   END IF;
   pos:=strpos(m.body,row.attempt_text);
   IF pos<=prev_pos OR pos=0 OR strpos(substr(m.body,pos+length(row.attempt_text)),row.attempt_text)>0
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEAL_SEGMENT_ORDER''; END IF;
   prev_pos:=pos; receipt_count:=receipt_count+1;
   UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4
      SET final_message_id=m.id,final_message_sha256=msg_sha,sealed_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE declaration_id=row.declaration_id AND sealed_at IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEAL_RACE''; END IF;
   receipts:=receipts||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(''slot_id'',row.slot_id,
    ''declaration_id'',row.declaration_id,''native_receipt_id'',row.native_receipt_id,
    ''attempt_sha256'',row.attempt_sha256)||CASE WHEN adaptive THEN jsonb_build_object(''resolution_kind'',resolution,''movement'',mov) ELSE ''{}''::jsonb END);
 END LOOP;
 IF receipt_count<>slot_count OR receipt_count<>cardinality(b.selected_actor_keys)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEAL_COHORT_INCOMPLETE''; END IF;
 RETURN receipts;
END $function$

';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.try_stage_deferred_png_v4(p_declaration uuid, p_text text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
DECLARE d public.combat_v2_declarations; hits integer; bind record; prior mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4;
 stage_batch mission_generic_owner.unified_batches; stage_writer mission_generic_owner.work_items;
 adaptive boolean:=false;c1266_qualified boolean:=false;c1266_att jsonb;c1266_contract jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM public.combat_v2_declarations WHERE id=p_declaration;
 -- Detect the active v4 batch from the Combat session, not only the round
 -- window: a missing window must fail closed, never fall through to mini-Fato.
 SELECT count(*) INTO hits FROM public.combat_v2_rounds r
  JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions s ON s.id=r.session_id
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.master_session_id=s.master_session_id
  WHERE r.id=d.round_id AND b.retired_at IS NULL AND b.state IN (''preparing'',''ready'')
    AND b.payload->>''schema_version''=''mission-generic-narration/4''
    AND b.composition_kind=''entry_png'';
 IF hits=0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF hits=1 THEN SELECT mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(b.writer_work_id) INTO adaptive FROM public.combat_v2_rounds r JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=r.session_id JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.master_session_id=cs.master_session_id WHERE r.id=d.round_id AND b.retired_at IS NULL AND b.state IN(''preparing'',''ready'') AND b.payload->>''schema_version''=''mission-generic-narration/4'' AND b.composition_kind=''entry_png'';END IF;
 IF hits<>1 OR auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service()
    OR NOT mission_generic_owner.unified_service_staging(d.round_id)
    OR (d.kind<>''attacco'' AND NOT(adaptive IS TRUE AND d.kind=''passa'' AND d.target_actor_id IS NULL)) OR (d.kind=''attacco'' AND d.target_actor_id IS NULL) OR d.state NOT IN (''inviata'',''risolta'')
    OR d.declaration_text IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(p_text,'''')
    OR length(btrim(coalesce(p_text,''''))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 320
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_DEFER_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 SELECT b.* INTO STRICT stage_batch FROM public.combat_v2_rounds r
  JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions s ON s.id=r.session_id
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.master_session_id=s.master_session_id
  WHERE r.id=d.round_id AND b.retired_at IS NULL AND b.state IN (''preparing'',''ready'')
    AND b.payload->>''schema_version''=''mission-generic-narration/4''
    AND b.composition_kind=''entry_png'';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT stage_writer FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=stage_batch.writer_work_id;
 IF stage_batch.decision->>''schema_version''=''mission-director-proposal/4'' THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(stage_batch.master_session_id,true)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  c1266_att:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_work_attest_v2(stage_writer.id);
  c1266_contract:=mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(stage_writer.id);
  IF c1266_att IS NULL OR (c1266_contract->''features'' ? ''role_intents_v2'') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (c1266_contract->>''scope'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(stage_writer.id) IS NULL)
   OR c1266_contract->>''work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_writer.id::text
   OR c1266_contract#>''{source_attestation,role_intents}'' IS DISTINCT FROM c1266_att
   OR c1266_att->>''decision_work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_batch.decision_work_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>''source_window_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_batch.source_window_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_writer.payload->>''source_revision''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_ATTESTATION'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';END IF;
  c1266_qualified:=true;
 END IF;
 IF stage_batch.decision->>''schema_version''=''mission-director-proposal/3'' THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v1(stage_batch.master_session_id,true)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  c1266_att:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_work_attest_v1(stage_writer.id);
  c1266_contract:=mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(stage_writer.id);
  IF c1266_att IS NULL OR (c1266_contract->''features'' ? ''role_intents_v1'') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (c1266_contract->>''scope'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(stage_writer.id) IS NULL)
   OR c1266_contract->>''work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_writer.id::text
   OR c1266_contract#>''{source_attestation,role_intents}'' IS DISTINCT FROM c1266_att
   OR c1266_att->>''decision_work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_batch.decision_work_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>''source_window_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_batch.source_window_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_writer.payload->>''source_revision''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_ATTESTATION'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';END IF;
  c1266_qualified:=true;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ((c1266_qualified AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(stage_batch.master_session_id,false,true) IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions fs
   JOIN public.master_v2_sessions ms ON ms.id=fs.master_session_id
   JOIN public.locations loc ON loc.id=ms.location_id
   WHERE fs.master_session_id=stage_batch.master_session_id AND fs.enabled
     AND ms.owner_kind=''ai_service'' AND ms.closed_at IS NULL AND loc.is_test)
)

 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_DEFER_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;

 SELECT b.id batch_id,b.source_window_id,d.round_id round_id,d.actor_id actor_id,
        map_actor->>''actor_key'' actor_key,slot->>''slot_id'' slot_id,slot_ord::integer slot_order,
        pp.work_id choice_work_id,pc.id panel_choice_id,pp.request_key panel_request_key
 INTO STRICT bind
 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.id=rw.batch_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items writer ON writer.id=b.writer_work_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_publication_permits pub ON pub.batch_id=b.id
 JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds round ON round.id=rw.round_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.encounters e ON e.encounter_id=round.session_id AND e.master_session_id=b.master_session_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.panel_permits pp ON pp.master_session_id=b.master_session_id
  AND pp.encounter_id=e.encounter_id AND pp.actor_id=d.actor_id
  AND pp.transaction_id=txid_current() AND pp.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
  AND pp.operation=''commit'' AND pp.consumed_at IS NULL AND pp.request_key=d.request_key
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pc ON pc.work_id=pp.work_id
  AND pc.actor_id=d.actor_id AND pc.encounter_id=e.encounter_id AND pc.request_key=pp.request_key
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.actor_map) map_actor
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(b.payload->''offense_slots'') WITH ORDINALITY AS slots(slot,slot_ord)
 WHERE rw.round_id=d.round_id AND rw.side=''png'' AND d.actor_id=ANY(rw.expected_actor_ids)
  AND rw.publication_id IS NULL AND b.state IN (''preparing'',''ready'')
  AND b.entry_side=''png'' AND b.composition_kind=''entry_png'' AND b.source_window_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (b.decision->>''schema_version''=''mission-director-proposal/2'' OR c1266_qualified)
  AND b.payload->>''schema_version''=''mission-generic-narration/4''
  AND b.payload IS NOT DISTINCT FROM writer.payload AND b.payload_sha256=writer.payload_sha256
  AND writer.kind=''narration'' AND writer.state=''provider_started''
  AND pub.work_id=writer.id AND pub.transaction_id=txid_current() AND pub.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
  AND map_actor->>''actor_id''=d.actor_id::text
  AND map_actor->>''actor_key''=slot->>''actor_key''
  AND slot->>''slot_id''=slot->>''actor_key''
  AND slot->>''actor_key''=ANY(b.selected_actor_keys)
  AND jsonb_typeof(slot)=''object'' AND mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(slot,ARRAY[''slot_id'',''actor_key''])
  AND slot->>''slot_id'' ~ ''^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$''
  AND slot->>''actor_key'' ~ ''^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$'';
 IF d.kind=''attacco'' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors target
   WHERE target.id=d.target_actor_id AND target.session_id=(SELECT session_id FROM public.combat_v2_rounds WHERE id=d.round_id)
     AND target.actor_kind=''pg'' AND target.state=''attivo'')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_DEFER_TARGET'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO prior FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4 WHERE declaration_id=d.id;
 IF prior.declaration_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   IF prior.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM bind.batch_id OR prior.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.actor_id
      OR prior.attempt_text IS DISTINCT FROM p_text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_DEFER_REPLAY_CONFLICT''; END IF;
   RETURN true;
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4
  (declaration_id,batch_id,source_window_id,round_id,actor_id,actor_key,slot_id,slot_order,
   choice_work_id,panel_choice_id,panel_request_key,attempt_text,attempt_sha256)
 VALUES(d.id,bind.batch_id,bind.source_window_id,d.round_id,d.actor_id,bind.actor_key,bind.slot_id,bind.slot_order,
   bind.choice_work_id,bind.panel_choice_id,bind.panel_request_key,p_text,
   encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_text,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex''));
 RETURN true;
END $function$

';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.unified_publish_v4(p_work uuid, p_result jsonb, p_request uuid, p_raw_sha text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
DECLARE ww mission_generic_owner.work_items; ub mission_generic_owner.unified_batches;
        uw mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows; mm public.master_v2_sessions;
        opp jsonb; part jsonb; body text:=''''; txt text; route_result jsonb;
        source_kind text; role_ref uuid; role_actor uuid; role_sha text;
