        out jsonb; memory jsonb; anchor jsonb; chain text; body_sha text;
        seg_sha text; msg uuid; pub uuid; tr mission_generic_owner.trigger_receipts;
        combat_open jsonb; offense_receipts jsonb; sealed_receipts jsonb;
        slot_count integer; prose_chars integer:=0; seen_slots text[]:=''{}''::text[];
        slot_key text; slot_text text; offense_round uuid;
        ev public.mission_run_events; ob public.mission_run_outbox;
        literal_recovery boolean:=false; free_prose boolean:=false;
BEGIN
  -- Named SQL maintenance authority: real postgres connection, no JWT impersonation.
  -- No client entry point, no retry state, no provider call.
  literal_recovery:=session_user=''postgres'' AND auth.uid() IS NULL
    AND coalesce(auth.role(),'''')='''' AND p_work=''8da0b3ea-3de5-4f1c-9cf9-740b54a33647''::uuid;
  IF NOT literal_recovery THEN PERFORM mission_ai_board_owner.service_only(); END IF;
  -- Caller finalizer MUST hold role cursor before Master/work; this lock is
  -- reentrant and verifies the same role revision under serialization.
  PERFORM 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors
    WHERE master_session_id=(SELECT master_session_id FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work)
    FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_CURSOR_MISSING''; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT mm FROM public.master_v2_sessions
    WHERE id=(SELECT master_session_id FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work)
    FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT ww FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work FOR UPDATE;
 IF mission_generic_owner.c1266_opening_named_v1(ww.master_session_id) AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(ww.master_session_id,false,true) IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_PUBLISH5_CURRENT_AUTHORITY'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  free_prose:=coalesce(mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(ww.id)->''features'' ? ''free_narrative_v1'',false);
  SELECT * INTO STRICT ub FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches
    WHERE id=ww.authority_receipt_id AND writer_work_id=ww.id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT uw FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows
    WHERE id=ub.source_window_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF literal_recovery THEN
    IF (
      ww.id=''8da0b3ea-3de5-4f1c-9cf9-740b54a33647''::uuid
      AND ww.master_session_id=''44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac''::uuid
      AND ww.kind=''narration'' AND ww.state=''failed'' AND ww.message_id IS NULL
      AND ww.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND ww.result IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_result
      AND ww.request_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_request
      AND ww.result_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_raw_sha
      AND p_raw_sha=''c540de05a0a5b7c5c3760b951b1d278863a5e13ce74c184f61106890e3cd8564''
      AND public.combat_v2_sha256(ww.result)=''514156423647274196abccda69d8f7ac94fee2a949d026526d50027f3f6aba03''
      AND ww.result->>''ok''=''true'' AND ww.result->>''provider_calls''=''1''
      AND ww.result->>''outcome_uncertain''=''false''
      AND ww.result->>''work_id''=ww.id::text
      AND ww.result->>''master_session_id''=ww.master_session_id::text
      AND ww.result->>''request_key''=ww.request_key::text
      AND ww.result->>''payload_sha256''=ww.payload_sha256
      AND mm.location_id=''0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b''::uuid
      AND mm.owner_kind=''ai_service'' AND mm.closed_at IS NULL AND mm.stato=''in_corso''
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations l WHERE l.id=mm.location_id AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions f WHERE f.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND f.enabled)
      AND mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(ww.master_session_id) IS NOT NULL
      AND ub.id=''5d54201e-913a-44c8-9d30-7fe776cf63aa''::uuid
      AND ub.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND ub.writer_work_id=ww.id
      AND ub.state=''ready'' AND ub.message_id IS NULL AND ub.route IS NULL
      AND ub.composition_kind=''narrative_continuation''
      AND ub.encounter_key IS NULL AND ub.encounter_id IS NULL AND ub.next_round_id IS NULL
      AND ub.source_round_id IS NULL AND ub.entry_side IS NULL
      AND ub.decision->>''action_kind''=''context'' AND ub.decision->''opportunity_id''=''null''::jsonb
      AND ww.payload->''offense_slots''=''[]''::jsonb
      AND uw.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id
      AND uw.work_id=''f470a88c-3e64-41be-9a1c-a9e627faef9c''::uuid
      AND uw.superseded_at IS NULL AND uw.consumed_message_id IS NULL
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items dw WHERE dw.id=uw.work_id
        AND dw.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND dw.kind=''director'' AND dw.state=''completed'')
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c WHERE c.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id
        AND c.window_epoch=1 AND c.role_revision=2)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 x WHERE x.work_id=ww.id OR x.batch_id=ub.id)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_revisions x WHERE x.work_id=ww.id)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_sessions cs WHERE cs.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND cs.closed_at IS NULL)
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr
        JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit ga ON ga.receipt_id=dr.id AND ga.event_code=''generic_finalized''
        WHERE dr.id=ww.dispatch_receipt_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=ww.id
          AND dr.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND dr.request_key=ww.request_key
          AND dr.status=''success'' AND dr.dispatch_count=1 AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
          AND dr.charged_cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND dr.lease_token_sha256 IS NULL AND dr.lease_expires_at IS NULL
          AND ga.details->>''work_id''=ww.id::text AND ga.details->>''receipt_id''=ww.receipt_id::text
          AND ga.details->>''state''=''failed'' AND ga.details->>''stale''=''false''
          AND ga.details->>''outcome_uncertain''=''false''
          AND ga.details->>''application_error_code''=''MG_FATO_LITERAL_REPETITION''
          AND ga.details->>''application_error_sqlstate''=''22023''
          AND ga.details->>''result_sha256''=ww.result_sha256
          AND ga.details->>''result_jsonb_sha256''=public.combat_v2_sha256(ww.result))
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items other
        WHERE other.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND other.id<>ww.id
          AND other.state IN(''ready'',''claimed'',''authorized'',''provider_started'',''uncertain''))
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da
        JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=da.receipt_id
        WHERE dr.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id AND da.finalized_at IS NULL)
    ) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_LITERAL_RECOVERY_BINDING'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF ww.payload ? ''role_interpretation'' THEN
   PERFORM mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_work_attest_dispatch_v2(ww.id);
   IF ww.payload->''role_interpretation'' IS DISTINCT FROM ub.decision->''role_interpretation''
    OR ww.payload->''role_disposition'' IS DISTINCT FROM ub.decision->''role_disposition''
    OR ww.payload#>''{role_disposition,effective_opportunity_id}'' IS DISTINCT FROM ub.decision->''opportunity_id''
    OR (ww.payload#>>''{role_disposition,status}''=''context_fallback'' AND
      (ub.decision->>''action_kind''<>''context'' OR ub.encounter_key IS NOT NULL OR ub.entry_side IS NOT NULL
       OR jsonb_array_length(ub.decision->''npc_intents'')<>0))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_PUBLISH_DISPOSITION_DRIFT'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';END IF;
  END IF;
  IF ww.payload->>''schema_version''<>''mission-generic-narration/4''
    OR (ww.state<>''provider_started'' AND NOT literal_recovery) OR ww.request_key<>p_request
    OR ww.payload IS DISTINCT FROM ub.payload OR ww.payload_sha256<>ub.payload_sha256
    OR ub.state<>''ready''
    OR ub.source_window_id IS NULL OR uw.superseded_at IS NOT NULL
    OR uw.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
    OR ww.payload->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(ww.master_session_id)
    OR ww.payload->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM uw.context->>''source_revision''
    OR p_result->>''schema_version''<>''mission-generic-result/2''
    OR p_result->>''runtime_version''<>''mission-generic-runtime/2''
    OR p_result->''text''<>''null''::jsonb
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_result->''segments'')<>''array''
    OR jsonb_array_length(p_result->''segments'')=0
    OR jsonb_typeof(ww.payload->''offense_slots'')<>''array''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_NONOFFENSIVE_BINDING'' USING ERRCODE=''40001''; END IF;
  slot_count:=jsonb_array_length(ww.payload->''offense_slots'');
  IF slot_count>0 AND (ub.composition_kind<>''entry_png'' OR ub.encounter_key IS NULL
    OR ub.entry_side<>''png'' OR slot_count<>cardinality(ub.selected_actor_keys))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''40001''; END IF;
  -- Validate source and work while run/step still match pre-transition state.
  PERFORM mission_generic_owner.work_assert(ww);
  IF mission_generic_owner.unified_batch_payload(ub.id) IS DISTINCT FROM ww.payload
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_PAYLOAD_DRIFT'' USING ERRCODE=''40001''; END IF;
  FOR part IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->''segments'') LOOP
    IF NOT mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(part,ARRAY[''kind'',''text'',''slot_id'',''actor_key''])
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEGMENT_KEYS''; END IF;
    IF part->>''kind''=''prose'' THEN
      IF jsonb_typeof(part->''text'')<>''string''
        OR part->''slot_id''<>''null''::jsonb OR part->''actor_key''<>''null''::jsonb
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_PROSE_SEGMENT_INVALID''; END IF;
      txt:=btrim(part->>''text'');
      IF txt='''' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_EMPTY_SEGMENT''; END IF;
      prose_chars:=prose_chars+length(txt);
    ELSIF part->>''kind''=''offense_slot'' THEN
      slot_key:=part->>''slot_id'';
      IF part->''text''<>''null''::jsonb OR slot_key IS DISTINCT FROM part->>''actor_key''
        OR slot_key !~ ''^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$''
        OR slot_key=ANY(seen_slots)
        OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(ww.payload->''offense_slots'') slot
           WHERE slot->>''slot_id''=slot_key AND slot->>''actor_key''=slot_key)
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_SEGMENT_INVALID''; END IF;
      seen_slots:=array_append(seen_slots,slot_key);
    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEGMENT_KIND''; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF prose_chars<(CASE WHEN free_prose THEN 1 ELSE 500 END) OR cardinality(seen_slots)<>slot_count
    OR seen_slots IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce((SELECT array_agg(slot->>''slot_id'' ORDER BY slot->>''actor_key'')
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(ww.payload->''offense_slots'') slot),''{}''::text[])
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEGMENT_COHORT''; END IF;
  seg_sha:=public.combat_v2_sha256(p_result->''segments'');
  anchor:=p_result->''history_anchor''; memory:=p_result->''continuity_draft'';
  IF jsonb_typeof(anchor) IS DISTINCT FROM ''object''
    OR jsonb_typeof(memory) IS DISTINCT FROM ''object''
    OR anchor->>''chain_sha256'' IS DISTINCT FROM ww.payload#>>''{source_context,history_chain_sha256}''
    OR (anchor->>''count'')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM (ww.payload#>>''{source_context,history_count}'')::bigint
    OR NOT mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(memory,ARRAY[''state'',''known'',''open'',''used''])
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_MEMORY_BINDING''; END IF;

  SELECT x INTO opp FROM jsonb_array_elements(uw.opportunities) x
    WHERE x->>''opportunity_id''=ub.decision->>''opportunity_id'';
  IF opp IS NULL AND (
      ub.decision->>''opportunity_id'' IS NOT NULL
      OR ub.decision->>''action_kind'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''context''
      OR ub.composition_kind IS DISTINCT FROM ''narrative_continuation''
      OR ub.encounter_key IS NOT NULL OR ub.entry_side IS NOT NULL
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OPPORTUNITY_MISSING''; END IF;
  IF opp->>''trigger_key'' IS NOT NULL THEN
    source_kind:=opp->>''source_kind'';
    IF source_kind=''player_choice'' THEN
      role_ref:=(ub.decision#>>''{source_evidence,0,role_id}'')::uuid;
      SELECT rm.character_id,encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rm.body,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex'')
        INTO STRICT role_actor,role_sha FROM public.messages rm
        JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp
          ON mp.session_id=ww.master_session_id AND mp.character_id=rm.character_id
          AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state=''attivo''
        JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=rm.character_id
          AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
        WHERE rm.id=role_ref AND rm.id=ANY(uw.role_ids)
          AND rm.location_id=mm.location_id AND rm.kind=''say'' AND rm.recipient_user IS NULL
          AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(ww.master_session_id) role_row
            WHERE role_row.message_id=rm.id AND role_row.valid)
          AND position(ub.decision#>>''{source_evidence,0,quote}'' in rm.body)>0
          AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_submissions current_submission
            JOIN mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors current_cursor
              ON current_cursor.master_session_id=current_submission.master_session_id
             AND current_cursor.window_epoch=current_submission.window_epoch
            WHERE current_submission.master_session_id=ww.master_session_id
              AND current_submission.message_id=rm.id);
    ELSIF source_kind=''narrative_event'' THEN
      role_ref:=ub.id;role_actor:=NULL;role_sha:=ub.decision_sha256;
    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_TRANSITION_KIND''; END IF;
    INSERT INTO mission_generic_owner.unified_publication_permits
      (batch_id,work_id,transaction_id,backend_pid)
    VALUES(ub.id,ww.id,txid_current(),pg_backend_pid());
    route_result:=mission_generic_owner.apply_authority(
      ww.master_session_id,mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(ub.id,''transition''),
      mm.control_version,ww.run_control_version,opp->>''trigger_key'',
      source_kind,role_ref,role_sha,role_actor);
    UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_batches SET route=route_result,
      step_key=(SELECT current_step_key FROM public.mission_run_state
        WHERE master_session_id=ww.master_session_id),
      run_control_version=(SELECT control_version FROM public.mission_run_state
        WHERE master_session_id=ww.master_session_id)
      WHERE id=ub.id;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT ub FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches WHERE id=ub.id;
  END IF;

  -- L''incontro e le offerte native restano invisibili finché questa
  -- transazione non pubblica l''unico Fato. Il trigger di round_init crea la
  -- finestra della coorte offensiva quando open_core inserisce il round.
  IF ub.encounter_key IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF ub.composition_kind NOT IN (''entry_pg'',''entry_png'',''entry_png_deferred'')
      OR ub.encounter_id IS NOT NULL OR ub.next_round_id IS NOT NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_COMBAT_ENTRY_ORDER''; END IF;
    UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_batches SET state=''preparing'' WHERE id=ub.id;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources WHERE session_id=ub.master_session_id) THEN
      PERFORM mission_factory_owner.quest_entry_permit_issue_v1(ub.id,ww.id,
        mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(ub.id,''open''),nullif(route_result->>''authority_receipt_id'','''')::uuid);
    END IF;
    combat_open:=public.mission_generic_combat_open_v1(
      ub.master_session_id,ub.encounter_key,ub.run_control_version,
      mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(ub.id,''open''));
    UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_batches SET
      encounter_id=(combat_open->>''encounter_id'')::uuid,
      next_round_id=(SELECT id FROM public.combat_v2_rounds
        WHERE session_id=(combat_open->>''encounter_id'')::uuid
        ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1)
      WHERE id=ub.id;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT ub FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches WHERE id=ub.id;
    IF ub.encounter_id IS NULL OR ub.next_round_id IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_COMBAT_ROUND_MISSING''; END IF;
    offense_round:=ub.next_round_id;
    IF slot_count>0 THEN
      offense_receipts:=mission_generic_owner.unified_stage_offense_v4(
        ub.id,ub.encounter_id,offense_round);
      IF offense_receipts->>''schema_version'' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(ww.id) THEN ''mission-entry-action-receipts/1'' ELSE ''mission-entry-offense-receipts/1'' END)
        OR offense_receipts->>''batch_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM ub.id::text
        OR offense_receipts->>''encounter_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM ub.encounter_id::text
        OR offense_receipts->>''round_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM offense_round::text
        OR jsonb_array_length(offense_receipts->''slots'')<>slot_count
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_NATIVE_OFFENSE_RECEIPT''; END IF;
    END IF;
  ELSIF slot_count>0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_WITHOUT_COMBAT'';
  END IF;

  -- Il provider non sceglie bersagli, offerte o esiti. I segmenti IA vengono
  -- intercalati con i tentativi testuali della ricevuta meccanica server.
  FOR part IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_result->''segments'') LOOP
    IF part->>''kind''=''prose'' THEN
      txt:=btrim(part->>''text'');
    ELSE
      SELECT receipt->>''attempt_text'' INTO STRICT txt
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(offense_receipts->''slots'') receipt
        WHERE receipt->>''slot_id''=part->>''slot_id''
          AND receipt->>''actor_key''=part->>''actor_key'';
      IF nullif(btrim(txt),'''') IS NULL OR length(txt)>320
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_NATIVE_ATTEMPT_TEXT''; END IF;
    END IF;
    body:=body||CASE WHEN body='''' THEN '''' ELSE '' '' END||txt;
  END LOOP;
  IF length(body) NOT BETWEEN (CASE WHEN free_prose THEN 1 ELSE 500 END) AND (CASE WHEN free_prose THEN 5000+321*slot_count ELSE 5000 END) OR body IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(body)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_BODY_LENGTH''; END IF;
  IF NOT free_prose THEN PERFORM mission_generic_owner.assert_no_literal_reuse(ww.master_session_id,body);END IF;
  body_sha:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(body,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex'');
  chain:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(anchor->>''chain_sha256''||'':''||body_sha,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex'');
  memory:=memory||jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-continuity/1'',
    ''work_id'',ww.id,''covered_count'',(anchor->>''count'')::bigint+1,
    ''chain_sha256'',chain,''text_sha256'',body_sha);

  -- Publication follows route in this SAME transaction. Do not call the
  -- legacy publisher: it re-runs work_assert against the advanced route.
  INSERT INTO public.messages(location_id,character_id,author_name,body,kind,
    sender_user,recipient_user)
    VALUES(mm.location_id,NULL,''Fato'',body,''fato'',NULL,NULL)
    RETURNING id INTO msg;
  IF msg IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_FATO_MISSING''; END IF;
  IF slot_count>0 THEN
    sealed_receipts:=mission_generic_owner.seal_deferred_png_v4(ub.id,msg);
    IF jsonb_array_length(sealed_receipts)<>slot_count
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SEAL_RECEIPT_COUNT''; END IF;
  END IF;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows SET publication_id=msg
    WHERE batch_id=ub.id AND publication_id IS NULL;
  IF slot_count>0 AND NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_ROUND_WINDOW_SEAL''; END IF;
  IF route_result IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT tr FROM mission_generic_owner.trigger_receipts
      WHERE id=(route_result->>''authority_receipt_id'')::uuid
        AND master_session_id=ub.master_session_id;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT ev FROM public.mission_run_events
      WHERE id=(tr.result->>''event_id'')::uuid AND status=''committed'';
    SELECT * INTO STRICT ob FROM public.mission_run_outbox
      WHERE event_id=ev.id AND state=''pending'' FOR UPDATE;
    IF ob.master_session_id<>ub.master_session_id
      OR ob.context_fingerprint<>ev.context_fingerprint
      OR ob.step_key<>ev.step_after
      OR ob.event_version_after<>ev.version_after
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OUTBOX_DRIFT''; END IF;
    pub:=gen_random_uuid();
    INSERT INTO public.mission_run_publications
      (id,master_session_id,event_id,request_key_sha256,request_fingerprint,
       source,expected_run_control_version,expected_event_version_after,
       expected_step_key,context_fingerprint,body_sha256,status)
    VALUES(pub,ub.master_session_id,ev.id,
      mission_internal.request_key_sha256(p_request),
      mission_internal.fingerprint(jsonb_build_object(''batch'',ub.id,''work'',ww.id,
        ''payload'',ww.payload_sha256,''body'',body_sha)),
      ''model'',ev.version_after,ev.version_after,ev.step_after,
      ev.context_fingerprint,body_sha,''committed'');
    INSERT INTO public.mission_run_messages(publication_id,message_id,body_sha256)
      VALUES(pub,msg,body_sha);
    PERFORM set_config(''app.mission_outbox_publish'',''on'',true);
    UPDATE public.mission_run_outbox SET state=''published'',publication_id=pub,
      published_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE event_id=ev.id;
    PERFORM set_config(''app.mission_outbox_publish'',''off'',true);
  END IF;
  PERFORM mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_regen_publish(p_work,msg);
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_batches SET state=''published'',message_id=msg,
    published_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=ub.id;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows SET consumed_message_id=msg
    WHERE id=ub.source_window_id;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors SET
    window_epoch=window_epoch+1,role_revision=0,
    last_published_fato_id=msg,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE master_session_id=ww.master_session_id
      AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(master_session_id)=
        ww.payload->>''source_revision'';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_CURSOR_ADVANCE_DRIFT''; END IF;
  INSERT INTO mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4
    (work_id,batch_id,message_id,raw_result_sha256,segments_sha256,
      final_text_sha256,source_revision,native_receipts)
  VALUES(ww.id,ub.id,msg,p_raw_sha,seg_sha,body_sha,
    ww.payload->>''source_revision'',coalesce(sealed_receipts,''[]''::jsonb));
  IF route_result IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM mission_factory_owner.c485_after_publication_v1(ub.master_session_id,(route_result->>''event_id'')::uuid,msg,ub.id);END IF;
  IF literal_recovery THEN
    -- The original provider result and failure remain immutable evidence.
    INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit(receipt_id,event_code,details)
    VALUES(ww.dispatch_receipt_id,''staff_literal_recovery_completed'',jsonb_build_object(
      ''schema_version'',''c1266-literal-recovery/1'',''work_id'',ww.id,''master_session_id'',ww.master_session_id,
      ''request_key'',ww.request_key,''batch_id'',ub.id,''message_id'',msg,
      ''original_state'',ww.state,''original_finalized_at'',ww.finalized_at,
      ''original_result'',ww.result,''original_result_sha256'',ww.result_sha256,
      ''original_result_jsonb_sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(ww.result),
      ''application_error_code'',''MG_FATO_LITERAL_REPETITION'',
      ''provider_calls_added'',0,''segments_sha256'',seg_sha,''final_text_sha256'',body_sha));
    UPDATE mission_generic_owner.work_items SET state=''completed'',message_id=msg,
      result=ww.result||jsonb_build_object(''text'',body,''continuity'',memory),
      result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(ww.result||jsonb_build_object(''text'',body,''continuity'',memory))
      WHERE id=ww.id AND state=''failed'' AND message_id IS NULL
        AND result IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ww.result AND result_sha256=ww.result_sha256
        AND finalized_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ww.finalized_at;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_LITERAL_RECOVERY_CAS'' USING ERRCODE=''40001''; END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(''batch_id'',ub.id,''message_id'',msg,
    ''publication_id'',pub,''transition'',route_result,''combat_open'',combat_open,
    ''offense_receipts'',coalesce(sealed_receipts,''[]''::jsonb),''text'',body,
    ''continuity'',memory);
END;
$function$

';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.unified_stage_offense_v4(p_batch uuid, p_encounter uuid, p_round uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
DECLARE b mission_generic_owner.unified_batches; writer mission_generic_owner.work_items;
        rw mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows; e mission_generic_owner.encounters;
        c mission_generic_owner.panel_choices; cw mission_generic_owner.work_items;
        offer combat_panel_private.offers; target_group combat_panel_private.choice_groups;
        target_option combat_panel_private.choice_options; move_group combat_panel_private.choice_groups;
        move_option combat_panel_private.choice_options; d public.combat_v2_declarations;
        slot jsonb; slot_order bigint; actor_key text; v_actor_id uuid; target_id uuid;
        slot_keys text[]; selected uuid[]; choice_status jsonb; command jsonb;
        result jsonb; receipt jsonb; work_result jsonb; attempt_text text;
        actor_display text; target_display text; candidate_offer record;
        diag_counts jsonb; diag_candidate_count integer:=0; diag_shape_rejected integer:=0; diag_pg_target_count integer:=0; diag_multiple_move_groups integer:=0; diag_move_shape_rejected integer:=0; diag_move_option_missing integer:=0; diag_extra_dependency_rejected integer:=0; found_selection boolean; slots jsonb:=''[]''::jsonb; location uuid;c1266_qualified boolean:=false;c1266_att jsonb;c1266_contract jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_SERVICE_ONLY'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches WHERE id=p_batch;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT writer FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=b.writer_work_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT rw FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows
  WHERE round_id=p_round AND batch_id=b.id AND master_session_id=b.master_session_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM mission_generic_owner.encounters
  WHERE encounter_id=p_encounter AND master_session_id=b.master_session_id;
 SELECT location_id INTO STRICT location FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=b.master_session_id;
 IF b.decision->>''schema_version''=''mission-director-proposal/4'' THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(b.master_session_id,true)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  c1266_att:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_work_attest_v2(writer.id);
  c1266_contract:=mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(writer.id);
  IF c1266_att IS NULL OR (c1266_contract->''features'' ? ''role_intents_v2'') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (c1266_contract->>''scope'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(writer.id) IS NULL)
   OR c1266_contract->>''work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM writer.id::text
   OR c1266_contract#>''{source_attestation,role_intents}'' IS DISTINCT FROM c1266_att
   OR c1266_att->>''decision_work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM b.decision_work_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>''source_window_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_window_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM writer.payload->>''source_revision''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_ATTESTATION'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';END IF;
  c1266_qualified:=true;
 END IF;
 IF b.decision->>''schema_version''=''mission-director-proposal/3'' THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v1(b.master_session_id,true)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  c1266_att:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_work_attest_v1(writer.id);
  c1266_contract:=mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(writer.id);
  IF c1266_att IS NULL OR (c1266_contract->''features'' ? ''role_intents_v1'') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (c1266_contract->>''scope'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(writer.id) IS NULL)
   OR c1266_contract->>''work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM writer.id::text
   OR c1266_contract#>''{source_attestation,role_intents}'' IS DISTINCT FROM c1266_att
   OR c1266_att->>''decision_work_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM b.decision_work_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>''source_window_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_window_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM writer.payload->>''source_revision''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_ATTESTATION'' USING ERRCODE=''40001'';END IF;
  c1266_qualified:=true;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ((c1266_qualified AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(b.master_session_id,false,true) IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions fs
   JOIN public.master_v2_sessions ms ON ms.id=fs.master_session_id
   JOIN public.locations loc ON loc.id=ms.location_id
   WHERE fs.master_session_id=b.master_session_id AND fs.enabled
     AND ms.owner_kind=''ai_service'' AND ms.closed_at IS NULL AND loc.is_test)
)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_publication_permits permit
   WHERE permit.batch_id=b.id AND permit.work_id=writer.id
     AND permit.transaction_id=txid_current() AND permit.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid())
 OR b.state NOT IN (''preparing'',''ready'') OR b.entry_side<>''png''
 OR b.composition_kind<>''entry_png'' OR (b.decision->>''schema_version''<>''mission-director-proposal/2'' AND NOT c1266_qualified)
 OR b.payload->>''schema_version''<>''mission-generic-narration/4''
 OR b.payload IS DISTINCT FROM writer.payload OR b.payload_sha256<>writer.payload_sha256
 OR b.payload->>''source_revision'' IS DISTINCT FROM mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(b.master_session_id)
 OR writer.state<>''provider_started'' OR writer.kind<>''narration''
 OR b.encounter_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_encounter
 OR e.encounter_key IS DISTINCT FROM b.encounter_key
 OR rw.side<>''png'' OR rw.publication_id IS NOT NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_rounds r
   WHERE r.id=p_round AND r.session_id=p_encounter)
 OR jsonb_typeof(b.payload->''offense_slots'')<>''array''
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_BINDING'' USING ERRCODE=''42501''; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(x->>''actor_key'' ORDER BY ord),''{}''::text[])
   INTO slot_keys FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.payload->''offense_slots'') WITH ORDINALITY AS q(x,ord);
 IF cardinality(slot_keys)=0 OR slot_keys IS DISTINCT FROM b.selected_actor_keys
   OR cardinality(rw.expected_actor_ids)<>cardinality(slot_keys)
   OR cardinality(slot_keys)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT actor_key_item) FROM unnest(slot_keys) AS t(actor_key_item))
   OR slot_keys IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT array_agg(actor_key_item ORDER BY actor_key_item) FROM unnest(slot_keys) AS t(actor_key_item))
   OR slot_keys IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT coalesce(array_agg(ni->>''actor_key'' ORDER BY ni->>''actor_key''),''{}''::text[])
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(b.decision->''npc_intents'',''[]''::jsonb)) ni
      WHERE ni->>''entry_kind''=''offense'')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_COHORT''; END IF;

 IF mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(writer.id) THEN
  INSERT INTO mission_generic_owner.unified_preparation_permits(round_id,batch_id,transaction_id,backend_pid) VALUES(p_round,b.id,txid_current(),pg_backend_pid());
  FOR slot IN SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.payload->''offense_slots'') WITH ORDINALITY q(x,ord) ORDER BY ord LOOP
   slots:=slots||jsonb_build_array(mission_generic_owner.native_entry_action_v1(b.id,p_encounter,p_round,slot));
  END LOOP;
  IF jsonb_array_length(slots)<>cardinality(slot_keys) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MIR_ENTRY_COHORT_INCOMPLETE'';END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-entry-action-receipts/1'',''batch_id'',b.id,''encounter_id'',p_encounter,''round_id'',p_round,''slots'',slots);
 END IF;
 FOR slot,slot_order IN SELECT x,ord FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.payload->''offense_slots'')
    WITH ORDINALITY AS q(x,ord) ORDER BY ord LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(slot)<>''object'' OR NOT mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(slot,ARRAY[''slot_id'',''actor_key''])
    OR slot->>''actor_key'' !~ ''^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$''
    OR slot->>''slot_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM slot->>''actor_key''
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_SLOT_INVALID''; END IF;
  actor_key:=slot->>''actor_key'';
  SELECT (map_actor->>''actor_id'')::uuid INTO STRICT v_actor_id
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.actor_map) map_actor WHERE map_actor->>''actor_key''=actor_key;
  IF NOT v_actor_id=ANY(rw.expected_actor_ids)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors a
      WHERE a.id=v_actor_id AND a.session_id=p_encounter AND a.actor_kind=''png''
        AND a.state=''attivo'' AND a.companion_id IS NULL)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_ACTOR_INVALID''; END IF;

  PERFORM set_config(''tus.native_attack_producer_called'',''false'',true);PERFORM set_config(''tus.native_attack_producer_diag'',jsonb_build_object(''targets_total'',0,''targets_seen'',0,''mano_seen'',0,''geometry_stay'',0,''endpoint_count'',0,''pending_count'',0,''rejected_geometry'',0,''label_present'',0,''legal_total'',0,''action_entered'',0)::text,true);
  choice_status:=mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(b.master_session_id,p_encounter,v_actor_id);
  IF choice_status->>''schema_version''<>''mission-generic-status/1''
    OR choice_status->>''state''<>''ready'' OR choice_status->>''work_id'' IS NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_CHOICE_NOT_READY''; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT cw FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items
    WHERE id=(choice_status->>''work_id'')::uuid AND master_session_id=b.master_session_id
      AND encounter_id=p_encounter AND kind=''choice'' AND state=''ready'' FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pc
    WHERE pc.work_id=cw.id AND pc.actor_id=v_actor_id AND pc.encounter_id=p_encounter AND pc.consumed_at IS NULL;
  IF cw.payload->>''actor_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_id::text
    OR cw.payload->>''capability_id'' IS DISTINCT FROM c.id::text
    OR cw.payload->>''command_request_key'' IS DISTINCT FROM c.request_key::text
    OR cw.payload#>>''{legal_options,context,round_id}'' IS DISTINCT FROM p_round::text
    OR c.legal_options#>>''{context,location_id}'' IS DISTINCT FROM location::text
    OR c.options_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(c.legal_options)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_CHOICE_BINDING''; END IF;

  found_selection:=false; target_id:=NULL; selected:=''{}''::uuid[];
  diag_candidate_count:=0;diag_shape_rejected:=0;diag_pg_target_count:=0;diag_multiple_move_groups:=0;diag_move_shape_rejected:=0;diag_move_option_missing:=0;diag_extra_dependency_rejected:=0;
  FOR candidate_offer IN SELECT o.id FROM combat_panel_private.offers o
   WHERE o.actor_id=v_actor_id AND o.principal_user=c.principal_id
     AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action''
     AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2''
     AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action''
     AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco''
     AND o.source_payload->>''ability_source''=''mano''
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''offers'') offered
       WHERE offered->>''offer_id''=o.id::text)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.input_fields f
       WHERE f.offer_id=o.id AND f.required)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g
       WHERE g.offer_id=o.id AND g.purpose NOT IN (''target'',''movement_distance''))
   ORDER BY o.id LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT offer FROM combat_panel_private.offers WHERE id=candidate_offer.id;
   diag_candidate_count:=diag_candidate_count+1;
   IF (SELECT count(*) FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g
      WHERE g.offer_id=offer.id AND g.purpose=''target'' AND g.depends_on IS NULL
        AND g.min_selected=1 AND g.max_selected=1)<>1
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g
      WHERE g.offer_id=offer.id AND g.depends_on IS NULL AND g.purpose<>''target'')
   THEN diag_shape_rejected:=diag_shape_rejected+1;CONTINUE; END IF;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT target_group FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g
    WHERE g.offer_id=offer.id AND g.purpose=''target'' AND g.depends_on IS NULL;
   FOR target_option IN SELECT q.* FROM combat_panel_private.choice_options q
     JOIN public.combat_v2_actors pg_target
       ON pg_target.id=(q.source_payload->>''target_actor_id'')::uuid
      AND pg_target.session_id=p_encounter AND pg_target.actor_kind=''pg''
      AND pg_target.state=''attivo'' AND pg_target.companion_id IS NULL
     WHERE q.offer_id=offer.id AND q.group_id=target_group.id
     ORDER BY q.distance_m NULLS LAST,pg_target.id,q.ordinal,q.id LOOP
     diag_pg_target_count:=diag_pg_target_count+1;
     target_id:=(target_option.source_payload->>''target_actor_id'')::uuid;
     selected:=ARRAY[target_option.id];
     IF (SELECT count(*) FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g
       WHERE g.offer_id=offer.id AND g.purpose=''movement_distance''
         AND g.depends_on=target_option.id)>1 THEN diag_multiple_move_groups:=diag_multiple_move_groups+1;CONTINUE; END IF;
     SELECT * INTO move_group FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g
      WHERE g.offer_id=offer.id AND g.purpose=''movement_distance''
        AND g.depends_on=target_option.id;
     IF move_group.id IS NOT NULL THEN
       IF move_group.min_selected<>1 OR move_group.max_selected<>1 THEN diag_move_shape_rejected:=diag_move_shape_rejected+1;CONTINUE; END IF;
       SELECT * INTO move_option FROM combat_panel_private.choice_options q
        WHERE q.offer_id=offer.id AND q.group_id=move_group.id
          AND q.source_payload ? ''movement_capability_id''
        ORDER BY q.distance_m NULLS LAST,q.ordinal,q.id LIMIT 1;
       IF move_option.id IS NULL THEN diag_move_option_missing:=diag_move_option_missing+1;CONTINUE; END IF;
       selected:=array_append(selected,move_option.id);
     ELSE
       IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g
         WHERE g.offer_id=offer.id AND g.depends_on=target_option.id) THEN diag_extra_dependency_rejected:=diag_extra_dependency_rejected+1;CONTINUE; END IF;
     END IF;
     IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g
       WHERE g.offer_id=offer.id AND g.depends_on=ANY(selected)
         AND g.id IS DISTINCT FROM move_group.id) THEN diag_extra_dependency_rejected:=diag_extra_dependency_rejected+1;CONTINUE; END IF;
     -- Native cardinality/dependency validator; no free target or option.
     PERFORM combat_panel_private.resolve_selections(offer.id,selected,''[]''::jsonb);
     found_selection:=true; EXIT;
   END LOOP;
   IF found_selection THEN EXIT; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF NOT found_selection OR target_id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(''actor_offers'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE true),''principal_match'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id),''offered'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered''),''action'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action''),''master_adapter'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2''),''action_dispatch'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action''),''attack'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco''),''mano'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco'' AND o.source_payload->>''ability_source''=''mano''),''in_projection'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco'' AND o.source_payload->>''ability_source''=''mano'' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''offers'') x WHERE x->>''offer_id''=o.id::text)),''no_required_inputs'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco'' AND o.source_payload->>''ability_source''=''mano'' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''offers'') x WHERE x->>''offer_id''=o.id::text) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.input_fields f WHERE f.offer_id=o.id AND f.required)),''supported_groups'',count(*)FILTER(WHERE o.principal_user=c.principal_id AND o.state=''offered'' AND o.kind=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''adapter''=''master_v2'' AND o.source_payload->>''dispatch''=''action'' AND o.source_payload->>''kind''=''attacco'' AND o.source_payload->>''ability_source''=''mano'' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''offers'') x WHERE x->>''offer_id''=o.id::text) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.input_fields f WHERE f.offer_id=o.id AND f.required) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_panel_private.choice_groups g WHERE g.offer_id=o.id AND g.purpose NOT IN(''target'',''movement_distance'')))) INTO diag_counts FROM combat_panel_private.offers o WHERE o.actor_id=v_actor_id;
    diag_counts:=diag_counts||jsonb_build_object(''candidate_count'',diag_candidate_count,''shape_rejected'',diag_shape_rejected,''pg_target_count'',diag_pg_target_count,''multiple_move_groups'',diag_multiple_move_groups,''move_shape_rejected'',diag_move_shape_rejected,''move_option_missing'',diag_move_option_missing,''extra_dependency_rejected'',diag_extra_dependency_rejected);
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_NO_LEGAL_NATIVE_ATTACK'' USING ERRCODE=''55000'',DETAIL=jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-native-attack-selection-diagnostic/2'',''actor_key'',actor_key,''round_phase'',(SELECT CASE WHEN phase IN(''raccolta_azioni'',''raccolta_difese'',''risoluzione'',''risolto'',''narrazione'',''narrato'') THEN phase ELSE ''other'' END FROM public.combat_v2_rounds WHERE id=p_round),''counts'',diag_counts,''producer_called'',coalesce(current_setting(''tus.native_attack_producer_called'',true),''false'')=''true'',''producer_counts'',coalesce(nullif(current_setting(''tus.native_attack_producer_diag'',true),''''),''{}'')::jsonb)::text; END IF;

  SELECT x->>''display_name'' INTO actor_display FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''actors'') x
    WHERE x->>''actor_id''=v_actor_id::text;
  SELECT x->>''display_name'' INTO target_display FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.legal_options->''actors'') x
    WHERE x->>''actor_id''=target_id::text;
  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(target_display,'''')),'''') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_TARGET_LABEL_MISSING''; END IF;
  attempt_text:=CASE slot_order WHEN 1 THEN ''Il primo avversario'' WHEN 2 THEN ''Il secondo avversario''
     WHEN 3 THEN ''Il terzo avversario'' ELSE ''L''''avversario numero ''||slot_order::text END;
  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(actor_display,'''')),'''') IS NOT NULL
  THEN attempt_text:=attempt_text||'' (''||actor_display||'')''; END IF;
  attempt_text:=attempt_text||CASE WHEN cardinality(selected)>1 THEN '' prova ad avvicinarsi a '' ELSE '' punta su '' END
     ||target_display||'' e tenta un colpo.'';
  IF length(attempt_text)>320 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_ATTEMPT_TEXT_LONG''; END IF;

  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.work_items SET state=''provider_started''
   WHERE id=cw.id AND state=''ready'' AND dispatch_receipt_id IS NULL AND authorization_id IS NULL
     AND dispatch_id IS NULL AND lease_id IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SYNTHETIC_WORK_STATE''; END IF;
  command:=jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''combat-panel-command/1'',
    ''request_key'',c.request_key,''location_id'',location,''activity_id'',p_encounter,
    ''context_version'',c.context_version,''offer_id'',offer.id,
    ''selected_option_ids'',to_jsonb(selected),''inputs'',''[]''::jsonb,
    ''narrative_text'',attempt_text);
  result:=mission_generic_owner.choice_commit(cw.id,c.id,command);
  IF result#>>''{receipt,declaration_id}'' IS NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_NATIVE_DECLARATION_MISSING''; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM public.combat_v2_declarations
    WHERE id=(result#>>''{receipt,declaration_id}'')::uuid AND round_id=p_round
      AND actor_id=v_actor_id AND target_actor_id=target_id AND kind=''attacco''
      AND declaration_text=attempt_text AND request_key=c.request_key;
  receipt:=mission_generic_owner.attest_deferred_png_v4(d.id,cw.id,result);
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_consumer_private.declaration_messages dm
    WHERE dm.declaration_id=d.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_MINI_FATO_FORBIDDEN''; END IF;
  work_result:=jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-generic-choice-synthetic/1'',
    ''slot_id'',slot->>''slot_id'',''command'',combat_panel_private.validate_command(command),
    ''native'',result,''declaration_id'',d.id,''attestation'',receipt);
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.work_items SET state=''completed'',result=work_result,
    result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(work_result),
    receipt_id=(result#>>''{receipt,receipt_id}'')::uuid,finalized_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE id=cw.id AND state=''provider_started'' AND finalized_at IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_SYNTHETIC_WORK_FINALIZE''; END IF;
  slots:=slots||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(''slot_id'',slot->>''slot_id'',
    ''actor_key'',actor_key,''actor_id'',v_actor_id,''target_actor_id'',target_id,
    ''choice_work_id'',cw.id,''offer_id'',offer.id,''selected_option_ids'',to_jsonb(selected),
    ''attempt_text'',attempt_text,''declaration_id'',d.id,
    ''native_receipt_id'',receipt->''native_receipt_id'',
    ''native_result_sha256'',receipt->''native_result_sha256''));
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(slots)<>cardinality(slot_keys)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''MRS_V4_OFFENSE_SLOT_COUNT''; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''mission-entry-offense-receipts/1'',
   ''batch_id'',b.id,''encounter_id'',p_encounter,''round_id'',p_round,''slots'',slots);
END $function$

';
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_public_owner.work_contract_issue_v1(p_work uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''''
AS $function$
declare w mission_generic_owner.work_items;b mission_generic_owner.run_bindings;
 a mission_public_owner.session_admissions_v1;q mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources;
 pub mission_factory_owner.publications;source_scope text;release_sha text;profile text;
 q49 jsonb;source_attestation jsonb;payload_version text;features jsonb:=''[]''::jsonb;doc jsonb;old jsonb;ignored jsonb;c5_proof jsonb;c5_native jsonb;c5_stamp jsonb;
begin
 select * into strict w from mission_generic_owner.work_items where id=p_work for update;
 old:=mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(w.id);
 if old is not null then return old;end if;
 IF mission_generic_owner.c1266_opening_named_v1(w.master_session_id) THEN
  c5_proof:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(w.master_session_id,false,true);
  c5_native:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_native_start_v1(w.master_session_id,false,true);
  IF c5_proof IS NULL OR c5_native IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_NARRATIVE5_ISSUE_CLOSED'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  release_sha:=c5_proof->>''release_sha256'';source_scope:=CASE WHEN c5_proof#>>''{admission,resource_scope}''=''world'' THEN ''public_mission'' ELSE ''staff_mission'' END;
  c5_stamp:=jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''c1266-work-execution-attestation/1'',''execution_context'',c5_proof->>''execution_context'',
   ''admission'',c5_proof->''admission'',''release_sha256'',release_sha,''binding_sha256'',c5_proof->>''binding_sha256'',
   ''financial_qualification_sha256'',c5_proof->>''financial_qualification_sha256'',''c7_budget_qualification_sha256'',c5_proof->>''c7_budget_qualification_sha256'',
   ''start_receipt_id'',c5_native->>''start_receipt_id'',''start_snapshot_sha256'',c5_native#>>''{eligibility,board_snapshot_sha256}'',
   ''source_scope'',(SELECT canonical_preimage::jsonb#>''{config,c1266_opening,source_scope}'' FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton));
 q49:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_staff_source_scope_v1(w.master_session_id);
 IF q49 IS NOT NULL THEN
 c5_stamp:=c5_stamp||jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''c1266-work-execution-attestation/2'',''source_scope'',q49->''source_scope'',''source_qualification'',q49,''source_qualification_sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(q49));
 END IF;
 q49:=mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(w.master_session_id);
 IF q49 IS NOT NULL THEN
  c5_stamp:=c5_stamp||jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''c1266-work-execution-attestation/3'',''source_scope'',q49->''source_scope'',''source_qualification'',q49,''source_qualification_sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(q49));
 END IF;
 ELSIF mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v1(w.master_session_id,true) THEN
  ignored:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_clean_staff_admission_v1(w.master_session_id,true,true);
  release_sha:=ignored->>''release_sha256'';source_scope:=''staff_mission'';
 ELSIF exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs where qs.session_id=w.master_session_id and qs.availability_scope=''public'' and qs.state in(''prepared'',''opening_pending'',''uncertain'',''started'')) then
  ignored:=mission_factory_owner.quest_run_source_assert_v1(w.master_session_id);
  select * into strict q from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=w.master_session_id;
  release_sha:=q.public_release_sha256;source_scope:=''public_quest'';
 elsif mission_public_owner.role_session_allowed_v1(w.master_session_id) then
  select * into strict a from mission_public_owner.session_admissions_v1 where master_session_id=w.master_session_id;
  release_sha:=a.release_sha256;source_scope:=''public_mission'';
 elsif exists(select 1 from mission_launch_owner.dual_decisions d
  join mission_launch_owner.dual_scopes s on s.mission_id=d.mission_id and s.activation_id=d.activation_id
  where d.master_session_id=w.master_session_id) then
  ignored:=mission_public_owner.launch_provenance_v1(w.master_session_id);
  if ignored->>''availability_scope'' is distinct from ''staff''
  then raise exception ''NARRATIVE_STAFF_LAUNCH_PROVENANCE'' using errcode=''42501'';end if;
  release_sha:=ignored->>''release_sha256'';source_scope:=''staff_mission'';
 elsif exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
  join public.master_v2_sessions ms on ms.id=qs.session_id
  join public.locations l on l.id=ms.location_id
  where qs.session_id=w.master_session_id and l.id=''0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b''::uuid
   and l.is_active and l.is_test and ms.owner_kind=''ai_service'' and ms.mission_id is null
   and ms.closed_at is null and ms.suspended_at is null
   and qs.state in(''prepared'',''opening_pending'',''uncertain'',''started'')) then
  -- Same authoritative Factory assertion, not a second Quest engine.
  ignored:=mission_factory_owner.quest_run_source_assert_v1(w.master_session_id);
  select * into strict q from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=w.master_session_id;
  select p.* into strict pub from mission_public_owner.publications_v2 p
   join mission_factory_owner.quest_arcs arc on arc.publication_request=p.request_key where arc.id=q.arc_id;
  if pub.target<>''staff'' or pub.state<>''staff'' or pub.quest_arc_id is distinct from q.arc_id
  then raise exception ''NARRATIVE_QUEST_PUBLICATION_SCOPE'' using errcode=''42501'';end if;
  release_sha:=pub.release_revision_sha256;source_scope:=''staff_quest'';
 else return null;end if;
 if w.state<>''ready'' or w.kind not in(''director'',''narration'',''choice'')
 or w.payload_sha256 is distinct from public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 then raise exception ''NARRATIVE_WORK_CONTRACT_SOURCE'' using errcode=''40001'';end if;
 select * into strict b from mission_generic_owner.run_bindings where master_session_id=w.master_session_id;
 if b.snapshot_sha256 is distinct from w.definition_sha256
 or b.snapshot_sha256 is distinct from mission_internal.fingerprint(b.snapshot)
 then raise exception ''NARRATIVE_WORK_CONTRACT_BINDING'' using errcode=''40001'';end if;
 payload_version:=w.payload->>''schema_version'';
 profile:=case when w.kind in(''narration'',''director'') then ''cinematic_master_1'' else ''legacy'' end;
 if w.kind=''director'' and (payload_version in(''mission-director-work/1'',''mission-director-work/2'',''mission-director-work/3'') OR(payload_version=''mission-director-work/4'' AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(w.master_session_id,true) AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_work_attest_v2(w.id) IS NOT NULL)) then
  if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw
   where sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id and sw.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
    and sw.work_id=w.id and sw.definition_sha256=w.definition_sha256
    and sw.step_key=w.step_key and sw.run_control_version=w.run_control_version)
  then raise exception ''NARRATIVE_DIRECTOR_SOURCE_RECEIPT'' using errcode=''40001'';end if;
  features:=jsonb_build_array(''director_progression'',''speech_intent'');
 elsif w.kind=''narration'' and payload_version in(''mission-generic-narration/3'',''mission-generic-narration/4'') then
  if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
   where ub.id=w.authority_receipt_id and ub.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
    and ub.writer_work_id=w.id and ub.payload_sha256=w.payload_sha256
    and ub.state=''ready'')
  then raise exception ''NARRATIVE_WRITER_BATCH_RECEIPT'' using errcode=''40001'';end if;
  features:=jsonb_build_array(case payload_version when ''mission-generic-narration/3''
    then ''unified_narration_v3'' else ''segmented_narration_v4'' end);
 elsif w.kind=''narration'' and payload_version in(''mission-generic-narration/1'',''mission-generic-narration/2'') then
  if jsonb_array_length(coalesce(w.payload->''roleless_declarations'',''[]''::jsonb))>0 then
   raise exception ''NARRATIVE_ROLELESS_REQUIRES_NATIVE_UNIFIED_ROUTE'' using errcode=''55000'';end if;
 elsif w.kind<>''choice'' then
  raise exception ''NARRATIVE_WORK_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED'' using errcode=''55000'';
 end if;
 source_attestation:=mission_public_owner.narrative_source_attest_v1(w.id)||jsonb_build_object(''master_session_id'',w.master_session_id,''definition_sha256'',w.definition_sha256,''release_sha256'',release_sha);
 IF source_attestation#>>''{role_intents,schema_version}'' IN(''mission-role-intent-attestation/2'',''mission-role-intent-attestation/3'',''mission-role-intent-attestation/4'') THEN
  IF source_attestation#>>''{role_intents,schema_version}''=''mission-role-intent-attestation/4'' AND(source_scope IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' OR source_attestation#>>''{role_intents,temporal_contract_sha256}'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''0603ab23e76750b5babeb41421bc84b551b959945f21267ffd7169140732f1e8'' OR source_attestation#>>''{role_intents,peer_confirmation,schema_version}'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''mission-peer-confirmation-contract/2'') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_PEER_FEATURE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  IF source_attestation#>>''{role_intents,schema_version}''=''mission-role-intent-attestation/3'' AND (source_scope IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' OR source_attestation#>>''{role_intents,temporal_contract_sha256}'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''3fdeaa942bcf3ba217a976f7b0896f4594721fa45cde9ff8ed7bddf15391feda'' OR source_attestation#>>''{role_intents,peer_confirmation,schema_version}'' IS DISTINCT FROM ''mission-peer-confirmation-contract/1'') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_PEER_FEATURE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(w.master_session_id,true) OR (source_scope IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' AND c5_proof IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_TEMPORAL_FEATURE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  features:=features||jsonb_build_array(''role_intents_v2'');
 ELSIF source_attestation->''role_intents'' IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v1(w.master_session_id,true)
   OR (source_scope IS DISTINCT FROM ''staff_mission'' AND c5_proof IS NULL)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''C1266_ROLE_FEATURE_SCOPE'' USING ERRCODE=''42501'';END IF;
  features:=features||jsonb_build_array(''role_intents_v1'');
 END IF;
 if jsonb_typeof(source_attestation->''peaceful_exit'')=''object'' then features:=features||jsonb_build_array(''peaceful_exit_v1'');end if;
 if jsonb_array_length(source_attestation->''continuity_sources'')>0 then
  features:=features||jsonb_build_array(''continuity_sources_v1'');
 end if;
 -- peaceful_exit is not inferred from the profile, caller or an arbitrary UUID.
 -- It requires a separate native legal capability; none is minted here.
 IF c5_stamp IS NOT NULL THEN source_attestation:=source_attestation||jsonb_build_object(''execution_authority'',c5_stamp);features:=features||jsonb_build_array(''execution_authority_v1'');END IF;
 IF source_scope=''staff_mission'' AND c5_stamp IS NOT NULL
  AND mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(w.master_session_id) IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness r WHERE r.singleton AND r.state=''enabled''
    AND r.revision_sha256=r.observed_revision_sha256
    AND r.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>''{config,c1266_free_narrative,enabled}''=''true''
    AND r.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>''{config,c1266_free_narrative,master_session_id}''=w.master_session_id::text)
  AND (w.kind=''director'' OR(w.kind=''narration'' AND payload_version=''mission-generic-narration/4'')) THEN
  features:=features||jsonb_build_array(''provider_output_retention_v1'');
  IF w.kind=''narration'' THEN features:=features||jsonb_build_array(''free_narrative_v1'');END IF;
 END IF;
 IF source_scope=''staff_mission'' AND c5_stamp IS NOT NULL AND mission_generic_owner.native_intent_policy_v1(w.master_session_id) IS NOT NULL
  AND ((w.kind=''director'' AND payload_version IN(''mission-director-work/3'',''mission-director-work/4''))
   OR(w.kind=''narration'' AND payload_version=''mission-generic-narration/4'' AND features?''free_narrative_v1'' AND features?''provider_output_retention_v1'')) THEN
  features:=features||jsonb_build_array(''native_intent_resolution_v1'');
 END IF;
 doc:=jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',case when c5_proof IS NOT NULL OR source_scope=''public_quest'' then ''mission-narrative-admission/3'' else ''mission-narrative-admission/2'' end,''scope'',source_scope,
  ''release_sha256'',release_sha,''work_id'',w.id,''master_session_id'',w.master_session_id,
  ''definition_sha256'',w.definition_sha256,''payload_sha256'',w.payload_sha256,
  ''payload_schema_version'',payload_version,''editorial_profile'',profile,''features'',features,''source_attestation'',source_attestation);
 insert into mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1(work_id,master_session_id,scope,release_sha256,
 definition_sha256,payload_sha256,contract,contract_sha256)
 values(w.id,w.master_session_id,source_scope,release_sha,w.definition_sha256,w.payload_sha256,doc,public.combat_v2_sha256(doc));
 return doc;
end $function$

''opening_header'',(SELECT jsonb_build_object(''signature'',''mission_generic_owner.opening_published(uuid,uuid)'',''oid'',p.oid::bigint,''owner'',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),''acl'',p.proacl::text,''config'',to_jsonb(p.proconfig),''secdef'',p.prosecdef,''volatility'',p.provolatile::text,''language'',l.lanname,''source_md5'',md5(p.prosrc),''ddl_md5'',md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE p.oid=''mission_generic_owner.opening_published(uuid,uuid)''::regprocedure),

t.label,c.rank,c.vita,c.vita_max,c.chakra,c.chakra_max,c.exp,c.xp_lifetime,c.money,c.pool_concesso,c.unspent_points,md5(jsonb_build_array(c.taijutsu,c.ninjutsu,c.genjutsu,c.forza,c.velocita,c.mente,c.resistenza,c.fuuinjutsu,c.kekkei_genkai,c.lealta,c.via,c.fama,c.slot_extra)::text) public.characters c on c.id=t.character_id order by t.label) select jsonb_build_object(''schema_version'',''c1266-protected-projection/1'',''captured_at'',clock_timestamp(),

 EXECUTE 'WITH scope AS(SELECT ''44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac''::uuid AS session_id)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 ''fati'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',m.id,''body_sha256'',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(m.body,''UTF8''),''sha256''),''hex''),''row_sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(m))) ORDER BY m.id)

 ''works'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',w.id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(w))) ORDER BY w.id) FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w,scope s WHERE w.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''roles'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''message_id'',r.message_id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(r))) ORDER BY r.message_id) FROM mission_generic_owner.role_submissions r,scope s WHERE r.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''batches'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',b.id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(b))) ORDER BY b.id) FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b,scope s WHERE b.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''source_windows'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',sw.id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(sw))) ORDER BY sw.id) FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw,scope s WHERE sw.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''cursor'',(SELECT public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(c)) FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c,scope s WHERE c.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''quota'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',q.id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(q))) ORDER BY q.id) FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls q,scope s WHERE q.scope_id=s.session_id),
 ''dispatch_receipts'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',d.id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(d))) ORDER BY d.id) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d,scope s WHERE d.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''work_contracts'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''work_id'',c.work_id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(c))) ORDER BY c.work_id) FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 c,scope s WHERE c.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''dispatch_audit'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',a.id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(a))) ORDER BY a.id) FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d ON d.id=a.receipt_id,scope s WHERE d.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''run_audit'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',a.id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(a))) ORDER BY a.id) FROM public.mission_run_audit a,scope s WHERE a.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''binding'',(SELECT public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(b)) FROM mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b,scope s WHERE b.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''session'',(SELECT public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(m)) FROM public.master_v2_sessions m,scope s WHERE m.id=s.session_id),
 ''run_state'',(SELECT public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(r)) FROM public.mission_run_state r,scope s WHERE r.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''retained_outputs'',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(''id'',o.id,''sha256'',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(o))) ORDER BY o.id) FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_outputs_v1 o JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items w ON w.id=o.work_id,scope s WHERE w.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''finish_receipts'',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(fr)) ORDER BY fr.request_key),''[]''::jsonb) FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_finish_receipts_v1 fr,scope s WHERE fr.master_session_id=s.session_id),
 ''active_work_count'',(SELECT count(*) FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w,scope s WHERE w.master_session_id=s.session_id AND w.state IN(''ready'',''claimed'',''authorized'',''provider_started'',''uncertain''))
) AS extra' INTO after_extra;
 IF (after_extra=before_extra) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NATIVE_INTENT_SCENE_KEEP' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE state IN('claimed','authorized','provider_started')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts WHERE status IN('reserved','authorized','provider_started')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND state IN('ready','claimed','authorized','provider_started','uncertain'))) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NATIVE_INTENT_ACTIVE_AFTER' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
END $usd_install$;COMMIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.try_stage_deferred_png_v4(p_declaration uuid, p_text text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE d public.combat_v2_declarations; hits integer; bind record; prior mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4;
 stage_batch mission_generic_owner.unified_batches; stage_writer mission_generic_owner.work_items;
 adaptive boolean:=false;c1266_qualified boolean:=false;c1266_att jsonb;c1266_contract jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM public.combat_v2_declarations WHERE id=p_declaration;
 -- Detect the active v4 batch from the Combat session, not only the round
 -- window: a missing window must fail closed, never fall through to mini-Fato.
 SELECT count(*) INTO hits FROM public.combat_v2_rounds r
  JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions s ON s.id=r.session_id
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.master_session_id=s.master_session_id
  WHERE r.id=d.round_id AND b.retired_at IS NULL AND b.state IN ('preparing','ready')
    AND b.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/4'
    AND b.composition_kind='entry_png';
 IF hits=0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF hits=1 THEN SELECT mission_generic_owner.native_intent_work_v1(b.writer_work_id) INTO adaptive FROM public.combat_v2_rounds r JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=r.session_id JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.master_session_id=cs.master_session_id WHERE r.id=d.round_id AND b.retired_at IS NULL AND b.state IN('preparing','ready') AND b.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/4' AND b.composition_kind='entry_png';END IF;
 IF hits<>1 OR auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service()
    OR NOT mission_generic_owner.unified_service_staging(d.round_id)
    OR (d.kind<>'attacco' AND NOT(adaptive IS TRUE AND d.kind='passa' AND d.target_actor_id IS NULL)) OR (d.kind='attacco' AND d.target_actor_id IS NULL) OR d.state NOT IN ('inviata','risolta')
    OR d.declaration_text IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(p_text,'')
    OR length(btrim(coalesce(p_text,''))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 320
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MRS_V4_DEFER_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT b.* INTO STRICT stage_batch FROM public.combat_v2_rounds r
  JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions s ON s.id=r.session_id
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.master_session_id=s.master_session_id
  WHERE r.id=d.round_id AND b.retired_at IS NULL AND b.state IN ('preparing','ready')
    AND b.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/4'
    AND b.composition_kind='entry_png';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT stage_writer FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=stage_batch.writer_work_id;
 IF stage_batch.decision->>'schema_version'='mission-director-proposal/4' THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(stage_batch.master_session_id,true)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  c1266_att:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_work_attest_v2(stage_writer.id);
  c1266_contract:=mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(stage_writer.id);
  IF c1266_att IS NULL OR (c1266_contract->'features' ? 'role_intents_v2') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (c1266_contract->>'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission' AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(stage_writer.id) IS NULL)
   OR c1266_contract->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_writer.id::text
   OR c1266_contract#>'{source_attestation,role_intents}' IS DISTINCT FROM c1266_att
   OR c1266_att->>'decision_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_batch.decision_work_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>'source_window_id' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_batch.source_window_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_writer.payload->>'source_revision'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_ATTESTATION' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
  c1266_qualified:=true;
 END IF;
 IF stage_batch.decision->>'schema_version'='mission-director-proposal/3' THEN
  IF NOT mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v1(stage_batch.master_session_id,true)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  c1266_att:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_work_attest_v1(stage_writer.id);
  c1266_contract:=mission_public_owner.work_contract_v1(stage_writer.id);
  IF c1266_att IS NULL OR (c1266_contract->'features' ? 'role_intents_v1') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (c1266_contract->>'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission' AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(stage_writer.id) IS NULL)
   OR c1266_contract->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_writer.id::text
   OR c1266_contract#>'{source_attestation,role_intents}' IS DISTINCT FROM c1266_att
   OR c1266_att->>'decision_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_batch.decision_work_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>'source_window_id' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_batch.source_window_id::text
   OR c1266_att->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM stage_writer.payload->>'source_revision'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ROLE_OFFENSE_ATTESTATION' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
  c1266_qualified:=true;
 END IF;
 IF NOT ((c1266_qualified AND mission_generic_owner.c1266_execution_authority_v1(stage_batch.master_session_id,false,true) IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions fs
   JOIN public.master_v2_sessions ms ON ms.id=fs.master_session_id
   JOIN public.locations loc ON loc.id=ms.location_id
   WHERE fs.master_session_id=stage_batch.master_session_id AND fs.enabled
     AND ms.owner_kind='ai_service' AND ms.closed_at IS NULL AND loc.is_test)
)

 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MRS_V4_DEFER_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

 SELECT b.id batch_id,b.source_window_id,d.round_id round_id,d.actor_id actor_id,
        map_actor->>'actor_key' actor_key,slot->>'slot_id' slot_id,slot_ord::integer slot_order,
        pp.work_id choice_work_id,pc.id panel_choice_id,pp.request_key panel_request_key
 INTO STRICT bind
 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.id=rw.batch_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items writer ON writer.id=b.writer_work_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_publication_permits pub ON pub.batch_id=b.id
 JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds round ON round.id=rw.round_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.encounters e ON e.encounter_id=round.session_id AND e.master_session_id=b.master_session_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.panel_permits pp ON pp.master_session_id=b.master_session_id
  AND pp.encounter_id=e.encounter_id AND pp.actor_id=d.actor_id
  AND pp.transaction_id=txid_current() AND pp.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
  AND pp.operation='commit' AND pp.consumed_at IS NULL AND pp.request_key=d.request_key
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pc ON pc.work_id=pp.work_id
  AND pc.actor_id=d.actor_id AND pc.encounter_id=e.encounter_id AND pc.request_key=pp.request_key
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.actor_map) map_actor
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(b.payload->'offense_slots') WITH ORDINALITY AS slots(slot,slot_ord)
 WHERE rw.round_id=d.round_id AND rw.side='png' AND d.actor_id=ANY(rw.expected_actor_ids)
  AND rw.publication_id IS NULL AND b.state IN ('preparing','ready')
  AND b.entry_side='png' AND b.composition_kind='entry_png' AND b.source_window_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (b.decision->>'schema_version'='mission-director-proposal/2' OR c1266_qualified)
  AND b.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/4'
  AND b.payload IS NOT DISTINCT FROM writer.payload AND b.payload_sha256=writer.payload_sha256
  AND writer.kind='narration' AND writer.state='provider_started'
  AND pub.work_id=writer.id AND pub.transaction_id=txid_current() AND pub.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
  AND map_actor->>'actor_id'=d.actor_id::text
  AND map_actor->>'actor_key'=slot->>'actor_key'
  AND slot->>'slot_id'=slot->>'actor_key'
  AND slot->>'actor_key'=ANY(b.selected_actor_keys)
  AND jsonb_typeof(slot)='object' AND mission_generic_owner.keys_valid(slot,ARRAY['slot_id','actor_key'])
  AND slot->>'slot_id' ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$'
  AND slot->>'actor_key' ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$';
 IF d.kind='attacco' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_actors target
   WHERE target.id=d.target_actor_id AND target.session_id=(SELECT session_id FROM public.combat_v2_rounds WHERE id=d.round_id)
     AND target.actor_kind='pg' AND target.state='attivo')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MRS_V4_DEFER_TARGET' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO prior FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4 WHERE declaration_id=d.id;
 IF prior.declaration_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   IF prior.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM bind.batch_id OR prior.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.actor_id
      OR prior.attempt_text IS DISTINCT FROM p_text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MRS_V4_DEFER_REPLAY_CONFLICT'; END IF;
   RETURN true;
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO mission_generic_owner.unified_deferred_declarations_v4
  (declaration_id,batch_id,source_window_id,round_id,actor_id,actor_key,slot_id,slot_order,
   choice_work_id,panel_choice_id,panel_request_key,attempt_text,attempt_sha256)
 VALUES(d.id,bind.batch_id,bind.source_window_id,d.round_id,d.actor_id,bind.actor_key,bind.slot_id,bind.slot_order,
   bind.choice_work_id,bind.panel_choice_id,bind.panel_request_key,p_text,
   encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'));
 RETURN true;
END $function$

R=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;N='/Users/antonello/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node';checks={};sources=[]
for p in sorted((R/'candidate_edge').rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file():continue
 target=p
 result=subprocess.run([N,'--check',str(target)],text=True,capture_output=True);assert result.returncode==0,(p.name,result.stderr);checks[str(p.relative_to(R/'candidate_edge'))]=True
b=(R/'baseline_edge/mission-generic-runtime.mjs').read_text();s=(R/'candidate_edge/mission-generic-runtime.mjs').read_text()
def region(text,start,end):return text.split(start,1)[1].split(end,1)[0]
checks['numeric_schema_and_decoder_unchanged']=region(b,'function bindC1266NumericEvidence(', 'const C1266_COMPACT_DIRECTOR_RULE')==region(s,'function bindC1266NumericEvidence(', 'const C1266_COMPACT_DIRECTOR_RULE') and region(b,'function c1266NumericLegacyInput(', 'const ADMISSION_FIELDS')==region(s,'function c1266NumericLegacyInput(', 'const ADMISSION_FIELDS')

 ''finish_receipts'',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(fr)) ORDER BY fr.request_key),''[]''::jsonb) FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_finish_receipts_v1 fr,scope s WHERE fr.master_session_id=s.session_id),

 IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE state IN('claimed','authorized','provider_started')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts WHERE status IN('reserved','authorized','provider_started')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND state IN('ready','claimed','authorized','provider_started','uncertain'))) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NATIVE_INTENT_ACTIVE_AFTER' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
END $usd_install$;NOTIFY pgrst,'reload schema';COMMIT;
