   AND pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND (pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request OR (rel.work_id='e76f31f2-eded-495e-9c5f-f03461c5cc3a'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_saved_director_application' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts rp WHERE rp.master_session_id=p_session AND rp.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id AND rp.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5('310493d3-92d2-4645-ba85-ab42f57dbf9d'::uuid,'mission-staff-unpublished-reinterpretation/1:ac9aedbd59dcb835d717f4ddb6ce195e3c2a9d640df576667290fa38b7e6cbbb') AND rp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(rp.result) AND rp.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)) OR (rel.work_id='433ace05-5265-4aad-96a3-5567b6e3480a'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_unpublished_reinterpretation' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_successor WHERE original_successor.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(t.request_key,'mission-staff-no-dispatch-resume/1:'||t.source_revision) AND original_successor.master_session_id=p_session AND original_successor.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id AND original_successor.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_successor.result) AND original_successor.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)) OR (
    rel.work_id='e366b9fa-54dc-4abd-8ba6-9ceee83be9a4'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_saved_director_application'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts retry_pr
     JOIN released origin ON origin.work_id='f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid AND origin.source_revision=t.source_revision
     WHERE retry_pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(origin.work_id,'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||t.source_revision)
      AND retry_pr.master_session_id=p_session AND retry_pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND retry_pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(retry_pr.result)
      AND pr.result->'dispatch'=origin.request AND retry_pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',cr.request),'request',cr.request,'work_id',cr.work_id,'receipt_id',cr.receipt_id,'result_sha256',cr.result_sha256,'release',cr.release) FROM combat_released cr
 ), bounded AS(SELECT DISTINCT item FROM items ORDER BY item LIMIT 128)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/3' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/2' ELSE 'mission-journal-settlements/1' END,'master_session_id',p_session,
  'items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result FROM bounded;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.c1266_count_terminal_proof_v1(p_work uuid, p_finalized boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_w mission_generic_owner.work_items;v_d mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;v_c staff_ai_quota_private.calls;
 v_hist jsonb;v_start jsonb;v_proof jsonb;v_snapshot jsonb;v_kind text;v_terminal jsonb;v_ticket uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO v_w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 IF NOT FOUND OR p_finalized IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 v_hist:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(v_w.id);
 IF v_hist IS NULL OR v_w.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(v_w.payload)
 OR v_w.lease_id IS NULL OR v_w.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR v_w.lease_expires_at>statement_timestamp()
 OR v_w.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR v_w.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL OR v_w.message_id IS NOT NULL
 OR v_w.dispatch_receipt_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF ((v_hist->>'execution_context'='staff_mission' AND v_hist#>>'{admission,kind}'='staff_finite'
  AND v_hist#>>'{admission,resource_scope}'='staff_simulation' AND v_hist#>>'{admission,location_id}'='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b')
 OR (v_hist->>'execution_context'='ordinary_mission' AND v_hist#>>'{admission,kind}'='ordinary_authenticated'
  AND v_hist#>>'{admission,resource_scope}' IN('world','staff_simulation'))) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF ((v_w.kind='director' AND v_w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/4')
 OR(v_w.kind='narration'AND v_w.payload->>'schema_version' IN('mission-generic-narration/2','mission-generic-narration/3','mission-generic-narration/4'))
 OR(v_w.kind='choice'AND v_w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-choice/1')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF p_finalized THEN
  IF v_w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed' OR v_w.finalized_at IS NULL OR v_w.receipt_id IS NULL
   OR v_w.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(v_w.result) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 ELSE
  IF v_w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'claimed' OR v_w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL OR v_w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
   OR v_w.result IS NOT NULL OR v_w.result_sha256 IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*)FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND v_a.event_code='c8_count_started')<>1
 OR(SELECT count(*)FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND v_a.event_code IN('c8_count_unknown','c8_count_success'))<>1
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT details INTO v_start FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit WHERE receipt_id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND event_code='c8_count_started';
 SELECT details INTO v_proof FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit WHERE receipt_id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND event_code IN('c8_count_unknown','c8_count_success');
 v_snapshot:=v_start->'policy_snapshot';
 IF (v_start->>'work_id'=v_w.id::text AND v_start->>'lease_id'=v_w.lease_id::text
  AND v_start->>'measurement_id'=v_proof->>'measurement_id'
  AND v_proof->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-count-proof/1'AND v_proof->>'work_id'=v_w.id::text
  AND v_proof->>'generation_allowed'='false'AND v_proof->>'count_http_calls'='1'AND v_proof->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
  AND v_start->>'generation_request_sha256'=v_proof->>'generation_request_sha256'
  AND v_start->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'=v_proof->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
  AND public.combat_v2_sha256(v_snapshot)=v_proof->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
  AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_start->>'generation_request_text','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=v_proof->>'generation_request_sha256'
  AND v_start->>'execution_context'=v_hist->>'execution_context'
  AND v_start->>'admission_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(v_hist->'admission')
  AND v_start->>'c7_budget_qualification_sha256'=v_hist->>'c7_budget_qualification_sha256'
  AND v_start->>'count_qualification_sha256'=v_hist->>'financial_qualification_sha256'
  AND v_start->>'shared_count_scope'=v_w.master_session_id::text AND v_start->>'shared_count_source'=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id::text
  AND v_start->>'shared_count_call_no'='2'
  AND public.combat_v2_sha256(v_start->'count_projection')=v_start->>'count_request_sha256'
  AND v_snapshot->>'model'='gpt-6-luna'AND v_snapshot->>'reasoning_effort'='high'AND v_snapshot->'store'='false'::jsonb
  AND v_snapshot->'input_usd_million'='0.1'::jsonb AND v_snapshot->'output_usd_million'='0.5'::jsonb
  AND ((v_start->>'provider_input_contract_version'='mission-generic-provider-input/6'
   AND v_hist->>'execution_context'='staff_mission'AND v_snapshot->>'schema_version'='c1266-staff-scene-count-snapshot/2'
   AND v_snapshot->>'release_sha256'=v_hist->>'release_sha256'
   AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(v_snapshot,ARRAY['policy_version','model','reasoning_effort','store','max_input_tokens','max_output_tokens','input_usd_million','output_usd_million','schema_version','scene_policy','scene_policy_sha256','scene_policy_contract_sha256','release_sha256','backing_origin'])
   AND v_snapshot->'scene_policy'='{"mode":"staff_scene_uncapped","maxCount":null,"maxGen":null,"maxHTTP":null,"maxUSD":null}'::jsonb
   AND v_snapshot->>'scene_policy_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(v_snapshot->'scene_policy')
   AND v_snapshot->>'scene_policy_contract_sha256'='1564720ca33bc961ff26fc15e07bd364ebd41a60b7a5a48c970a9c100038fad6')
  OR(v_start->>'provider_input_contract_version'='mission-generic-provider-input/5'
   AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(v_snapshot,ARRAY['policy_version','model','reasoning_effort','store','max_input_tokens','max_output_tokens','input_usd_million','output_usd_million'])))
  AND v_snapshot->>'max_input_tokens'='24000'AND v_snapshot->>'max_output_tokens'='20000'
  AND v_snapshot->>'max_input_tokens'=v_proof->>'max_input_tokens'
  AND v_start->>'shared_count_ticket'~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  AND v_start->>'count_upper_cost_usd'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF v_proof->>'state'='unknown'AND jsonb_typeof(v_proof->'input_tokens')='null' THEN v_kind:='MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_UNKNOWN';
 ELSIF v_proof->>'state'='success'AND(v_proof->>'input_tokens'~'^[0-9]+$')IS TRUE THEN
  IF(v_proof->>'input_tokens')::numeric<=(v_snapshot->>'max_input_tokens')::numeric THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  v_kind:='MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW';
 ELSE RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO v_d FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id;
 IF(v_d.master_session_id=v_w.master_session_id AND v_d.authority_receipt_id=v_w.id AND v_d.request_key=v_w.request_key
  AND v_d.event_kind='mission_generic_event'AND v_d.renderer_version='mission-generic-runtime/1'
  AND v_d.envelope->>'payload_sha256'=v_w.payload_sha256 AND v_d.dispatch_count=0 AND v_d.charged_cost_usd=0
  AND v_d.upper_bound_cost_usd IS NULL AND v_d.lease_token_sha256 IS NULL AND v_d.lease_expires_at IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_d.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_d.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls v_a WHERE v_a.source_id=v_d.id AND v_a.scope_id=v_w.master_session_id AND v_a.call_no=1))IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF p_finalized THEN
  IF v_d.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'OR v_d.finalized_at IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 ELSE IF v_d.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'claimed'OR v_d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;END IF;
 IF v_w.kind='director'AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows v_window
  WHERE v_window.id=v_w.authority_receipt_id AND v_window.work_id=v_w.id AND v_window.master_session_id=v_w.master_session_id
   AND v_window.source_sha256=v_w.payload_sha256 AND v_window.definition_sha256=v_w.definition_sha256
   AND v_window.step_key=v_w.step_key AND v_window.run_control_version=v_w.run_control_version
   AND v_window.consumed_message_id IS NULL AND v_window.superseded_at IS NULL)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- Effects of THIS work only: past public Fati and a sealed ready writer batch are preserved.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches v_b WHERE v_b.decision_work_id=v_w.id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 v_p WHERE v_p.work_id=v_w.id) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF v_w.kind='narration'AND v_w.payload->>'mode'='unified' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches v_b WHERE v_b.id=v_w.authority_receipt_id
   AND v_b.writer_work_id=v_w.id AND v_b.master_session_id=v_w.master_session_id AND v_b.state='ready'AND v_b.message_id IS NULL
   AND v_b.payload=v_w.payload AND v_b.payload_sha256=v_w.payload_sha256
   AND v_b.decision_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(v_b.decision)
   AND v_w.payload->>'batch_id'=v_b.id::text AND v_w.payload->>'preparation_receipt_id'=v_b.id::text
   AND v_w.payload->>'next_state_receipt_id'=v_b.id::text AND v_w.payload#>>'{publication_barrier,closed}'='true'
   AND v_w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,required_receipt_ids}'=v_w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,receipt_ids}'
   AND v_w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,receipt_ids}'@>jsonb_build_array(v_b.id)
   AND v_b.step_key=v_w.step_key AND v_b.run_control_version=v_w.run_control_version
   AND ((v_b.decision->>'schema_version'='mission-director-proposal/4'
    AND v_w.payload->'director_proposal'=v_b.decision-'role_disposition'
    AND v_w.payload->'role_disposition'=v_b.decision->'role_disposition'
    AND v_w.payload->'role_interpretation'=v_b.decision->'role_interpretation')
    OR(v_b.decision->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-director-proposal/4'AND v_w.payload->'director_proposal'=v_b.decision)))
  THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 v_ticket:=(v_start->>'shared_count_ticket')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO v_c FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls WHERE id=v_ticket;
 IF(v_c.producer='mission_generic_ai'AND v_c.scope_id=v_w.master_session_id AND v_c.source_id=v_d.id AND v_c.call_no=2
  AND v_c.state='unknown_billable'AND v_c.charged_usd IS NULL AND v_c.reserved_usd=0.0124
  AND v_c.reserved_usd=(v_start->>'count_upper_cost_usd')::numeric AND v_c.model=v_snapshot->>'model') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF p_finalized THEN
  IF(SELECT count(*)FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_d.id AND v_a.event_code='c1266_count_terminal')<>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  SELECT details INTO v_terminal FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit WHERE receipt_id=v_d.id AND event_code='c1266_count_terminal';
  IF(v_terminal->>'schema_version'='c1266-count-terminal-audit/1'AND v_terminal->>'work_id'=v_w.id::text
   AND v_terminal->>'receipt_id'=v_w.receipt_id::text AND v_terminal->>'result_sha256'=v_w.result_sha256
   AND v_terminal->>'payload_sha256'=v_w.payload_sha256 AND v_terminal->>'measurement_id'=v_proof->>'measurement_id'
   AND v_terminal->>'generation_request_sha256'=v_proof->>'generation_request_sha256'
   AND v_terminal->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'=v_proof->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'AND v_terminal->>'count_ticket'=v_ticket::text
   AND v_terminal->>'count_ticket_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(v_c))
   AND v_w.result->>'schema_version'='c1266-count-terminal-failure/1'AND v_w.result->>'failure_code'=v_kind
   AND v_w.result->'failure_codes'=jsonb_build_array(v_kind)
   AND v_w.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'AND v_w.result->>'count_http_calls'='1'AND v_w.result->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
   AND v_w.result->>'count_cost_state'='unknown_billable'AND v_w.result->'count_reserve_usd'=to_jsonb(v_c.reserved_usd)) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','c1266-count-terminal-proof/1','work_id',v_w.id,'master_session_id',v_w.master_session_id,
  'event_id',v_w.event_id,'request_key',v_w.request_key,'revision',v_w.revision,'dispatch_receipt_id',v_d.id,
  'measurement_id',v_proof->>'measurement_id','generation_request_sha256',v_proof->>'generation_request_sha256',
  'policy_snapshot_sha256',v_proof->>'policy_snapshot_sha256','release_sha256',v_hist->>'release_sha256','failure_code',v_kind,
  'count_ticket',v_ticket,'count_ticket_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(v_c)),
  'input_tokens',v_proof->'input_tokens','max_input_tokens',v_snapshot->'max_input_tokens');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(p_work uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE w mission_generic_owner.work_items;wc mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1;
 b mission_generic_owner.board_starts;rb mission_generic_owner.run_bindings;e jsonb;q49 jsonb;s49 mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources;m49 public.master_v2_sessions;cap49 mission_ai_service_owner.capabilities;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 SELECT * INTO wc FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 WHERE work_id=p_work;
 IF w.id IS NULL OR wc.work_id IS NULL OR wc.contract_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract)
 OR (wc.master_session_id,wc.definition_sha256,wc.payload_sha256) IS DISTINCT FROM(w.master_session_id,w.definition_sha256,w.payload_sha256)
 OR w.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 OR wc.contract->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-narrative-admission/3'
 OR NOT(wc.contract->'features' ? 'execution_authority_v1') THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 e:=wc.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority}';
 IF e->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/3' THEN
  DECLARE mq jsonb:=mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(w.master_session_id);ma jsonb;
  BEGIN
   ma:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','c1266-staff-admission-authority/3','kind','staff_finite','resource_scope','staff_simulation','finite_admission_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(mq),'admission_id',mq->>'start_receipt_id','location_id',mq->>'location_id');
   IF mq IS NULL OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(e,ARRAY['schema_version','execution_context','admission','release_sha256','binding_sha256','financial_qualification_sha256','c7_budget_qualification_sha256','start_receipt_id','start_snapshot_sha256','source_scope','source_qualification','source_qualification_sha256'])
   OR wc.scope IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission' OR e->>'execution_context' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission'
   OR e->'source_qualification' IS DISTINCT FROM mq OR e->>'source_qualification_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(mq)
   OR e->'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM ma OR e->'source_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->'source_scope'
   OR e->>'release_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM wc.release_sha256 OR e->>'binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.definition_sha256
   OR e->>'binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->>'binding_sha256'
   OR e->>'financial_qualification_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->>'financial_qualification_sha256'
   OR e->>'c7_budget_qualification_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->>'budget_qualification_sha256'
   OR e->>'start_receipt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->>'start_receipt_id'
   OR e->>'start_snapshot_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->>'start_snapshot_sha256'
   THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
   RETURN e;
  END;
 END IF;
 IF e->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/2' THEN
 q49:=e->'source_qualification';
 IF NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(e,ARRAY['schema_version','execution_context','admission','release_sha256','binding_sha256','financial_qualification_sha256','c7_budget_qualification_sha256','start_receipt_id','start_snapshot_sha256','source_scope','source_qualification','source_qualification_sha256']) OR ((q49->>'session_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'location_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'campaign_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'grant_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'start_receipt_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'binding_definition_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'capability_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'request_key') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'activation_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'start_snapshot_sha256') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (q49->>'binding_sha256') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (q49->>'capability_receipt_sha256') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (q49->>'request_fingerprint') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (q49->>'roster_sha256') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (q49#>>'{source_scope,definition_sha256}') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (q49#>>'{source_scope,plan_sha256}') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (q49#>>'{source_scope,source_sha256}') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (q49#>>'{source_scope,mission_id}') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49#>>'{source_scope,plan_version_id}') ~  ), combat_released AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT w.id work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
 jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) request,
 jsonb_build_object('source_work_id',w.id,'payload_sha256',w.payload_sha256,'reason','staff_combat_narration_preprovider_reissued','audit_sha256',proof.x->>'audit_sha256') release
 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT mission_generic_owner.combat_narration_reissue_proof_v1(w.id,p_user) x) proof
 WHERE w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.kind='narration' AND w.state='failed' AND w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/3'
 AND proof.x->>'audit_sha256' IS NOT NULL AND proof.x->>'successor_work_id' IS NOT NULL
 ), items AS(
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',s.request),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication) AS item
  FROM settled s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',s.request,'work_id',s.work_id,'receipt_id',s.receipt_id,'result_sha256',s.result_sha256,'publication',s.publication)
  FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr
   ON pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND (
    (pr.request_key=t.request_key AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256) OR (t.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid AND t.source_revision='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c' AND (p_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_count_limit_v1(p_session)='none'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 bt JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts bp ON bp.request_key=bt.request_key AND bp.master_session_id=bt.master_session_id AND bp.actor_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bp.result_sha256=bt.result_sha256 AND bp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(bp.result)
 WHERE bt.master_session_id=p_session AND bt.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid AND bt.source_revision='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c' AND bt.actor_user_id='b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid AND bt.staff_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bt.result_sha256='b27ed0db18a45d371931f015be0cd0fa060ed3f99b8d5843e8cbef45ecfbb2f8'
 AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(bp.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch','reason_code']) AND bp.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND bp.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text AND bp.result->>'state'='paused' AND bp.result->>'reason_code'='MGPG_C7_RUN_BUDGET_STOP' AND bp.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb)) AND pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(t.request_key,'mission-staff-budget-only-resume/1:'||t.source_revision))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_no_work
     WHERE original_no_work.request_key=t.request_key AND original_no_work.master_session_id=p_session AND original_no_work.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND original_no_work.result_sha256=t.result_sha256 AND original_no_work.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_no_work.result)
      AND (mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(original_no_work.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch'])
 AND original_no_work.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND original_no_work.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
 AND original_no_work.result->>'state'='needs_attention' AND original_no_work.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items healed 
 WHERE healed.master_session_id=p_session AND healed.created_at<t.created_at AND (healed.kind='director' AND healed.state='failed' AND healed.result->>'ok'='true'
 AND healed.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(healed.payload)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts healed_dr
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit healed_a ON healed_a.receipt_id=healed_dr.id AND healed_a.event_code='c1266_saved_director_applied'
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit healed_f ON healed_f.receipt_id=healed_dr.id AND healed_f.event_code='generic_finalized'
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches healed_b ON healed_b.decision_work_id=healed.id AND healed_b.master_session_id=p_session
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows healed_s ON healed_s.id=healed_b.source_window_id AND healed_s.work_id=healed.id AND healed_s.master_session_id=p_session
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items healed_writer ON healed_writer.id=healed_b.writer_work_id AND healed_writer.master_session_id=p_session AND healed_writer.authority_receipt_id=healed_b.id
  JOIN public.messages healed_msg ON healed_msg.id=healed_writer.message_id AND healed_msg.kind='fato' AND healed_msg.recipient_user IS NULL AND healed_msg.body=healed_writer.result->>'text'
  WHERE healed_dr.id=healed.dispatch_receipt_id AND healed_dr.master_session_id=p_session AND healed_dr.authority_receipt_id=healed.id AND healed_dr.request_key=healed.request_key
   AND healed_dr.status='success' AND healed_dr.dispatch_count=1 AND healed_dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND healed_a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-saved-director-application/1' AND healed_a.details->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
   AND healed_a.details->>'work_id'=healed.id::text AND healed_a.details->>'result_sha256'=healed.result_sha256
   AND healed_a.details->>'batch_id'=healed_b.id::text AND healed_a.details->>'writer_work_id'=healed_writer.id::text
   AND healed_a.details->>'generation_http_calls'='0' AND healed_a.details->>'failed_work_preserved'='true'
   AND healed_f.details->>'work_id'=healed.id::text AND healed_f.details->>'receipt_id'=healed.receipt_id::text
   AND healed_f.details->>'result_sha256'=healed.result_sha256 AND healed_f.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(healed.result)
   AND healed_b.state='published' AND healed_b.published_at IS NOT NULL AND healed_b.message_id=healed_writer.message_id
   AND healed_s.consumed_message_id=healed_b.message_id AND healed_s.superseded_at IS NULL
   AND healed_s.source_sha256=healed.payload_sha256 AND healed_writer.kind='narration' AND healed_writer.state='completed'
   AND healed_writer.payload=healed_b.payload AND healed_writer.payload_sha256=healed_b.payload_sha256
   AND healed_writer.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(healed_writer.payload)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 healed_pub WHERE healed_pub.work_id=healed_writer.id AND healed_pub.message_id=healed_msg.id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls healed_q WHERE healed_q.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND healed_q.scope_id=p_session AND healed_q.source_id=healed_dr.id AND healed_q.call_no=1 AND healed_q.state='settled' AND healed_q.charged_usd=healed_dr.charged_cost_usd)))))
      AND pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(t.request_key,'mission-staff-no-dispatch-resume/1:'||t.source_revision))

    OR EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM released rel
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_pr ON original_pr.request_key=t.request_key
      AND original_pr.master_session_id=p_session AND original_pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND original_pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256
      AND original_pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_pr.result)
      AND original_pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1'
      AND original_pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
      AND original_pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request
     WHERE rel.source_revision=t.source_revision
      AND pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(rel.work_id,
       'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||t.source_revision)))
   AND pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
  JOIN settled s ON s.request=pr.result->'dispatch'
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=s.work_id AND sw.master_session_id=p_session
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'=t.source_revision AND sw.consumed_message_id=(s.publication->>'message_id')::uuid
  WHERE t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=t.staff_user_id AND p.role IN('admin','master'))

  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',rel.request),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t ON t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision=rel.source_revision
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr ON pr.request_key=t.request_key
   AND pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND (pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request OR (rel.work_id='e76f31f2-eded-495e-9c5f-f03461c5cc3a'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_saved_director_application' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts rp WHERE rp.master_session_id=p_session AND rp.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id AND rp.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5('310493d3-92d2-4645-ba85-ab42f57dbf9d'::uuid,'mission-staff-unpublished-reinterpretation/1:ac9aedbd59dcb835d717f4ddb6ce195e3c2a9d640df576667290fa38b7e6cbbb') AND rp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(rp.result) AND rp.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)) OR (rel.work_id='433ace05-5265-4aad-96a3-5567b6e3480a'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_unpublished_reinterpretation' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_successor WHERE original_successor.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(t.request_key,'mission-staff-no-dispatch-resume/1:'||t.source_revision) AND original_successor.master_session_id=p_session AND original_successor.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id AND original_successor.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_successor.result) AND original_successor.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)) OR (
    rel.work_id='e366b9fa-54dc-4abd-8ba6-9ceee83be9a4'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_saved_director_application'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts retry_pr
     JOIN released origin ON origin.work_id='f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid AND origin.source_revision=t.source_revision
     WHERE retry_pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(origin.work_id,'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||t.source_revision)
      AND retry_pr.master_session_id=p_session AND retry_pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND retry_pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(retry_pr.result)
      AND pr.result->'dispatch'=origin.request AND retry_pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',cr.request),'request',cr.request,'work_id',cr.work_id,'receipt_id',cr.receipt_id,'result_sha256',cr.result_sha256,'release',cr.release) FROM combat_released cr
 ), bounded AS(SELECT DISTINCT item FROM items ORDER BY item LIMIT 128)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/3' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/2' ELSE 'mission-journal-settlements/1' END,'master_session_id',p_session,
  'items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result FROM bounded;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.c1266_count_terminal_proof_v1(p_work uuid, p_finalized boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_w mission_generic_owner.work_items;v_d mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;v_c staff_ai_quota_private.calls;
 v_hist jsonb;v_start jsonb;v_proof jsonb;v_snapshot jsonb;v_kind text;v_terminal jsonb;v_ticket uuid;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO v_w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 IF NOT FOUND OR p_finalized IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- Cheap necessary negative conditions precede expensive historical qualification; positive proof below is unchanged.
 IF v_w.lease_id IS NULL OR v_w.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR v_w.lease_expires_at>statement_timestamp()
  OR v_w.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR v_w.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL OR v_w.message_id IS NOT NULL OR v_w.dispatch_receipt_id IS NULL
  OR (p_finalized AND(v_w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed' OR v_w.finalized_at IS NULL OR v_w.receipt_id IS NULL OR v_w.result->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-count-terminal-failure/1'))
  OR (NOT p_finalized AND(v_w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'claimed' OR v_w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL OR v_w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL OR v_w.result IS NOT NULL OR v_w.result_sha256 IS NOT NULL)) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 v_hist:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(v_w.id);
 IF v_hist IS NULL OR v_w.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(v_w.payload)
 OR v_w.lease_id IS NULL OR v_w.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR v_w.lease_expires_at>statement_timestamp()
 OR v_w.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR v_w.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL OR v_w.message_id IS NOT NULL
 OR v_w.dispatch_receipt_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF ((v_hist->>'execution_context'='staff_mission' AND v_hist#>>'{admission,kind}'='staff_finite'
  AND v_hist#>>'{admission,resource_scope}'='staff_simulation' AND v_hist#>>'{admission,location_id}'='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b')
 OR (v_hist->>'execution_context'='ordinary_mission' AND v_hist#>>'{admission,kind}'='ordinary_authenticated'
  AND v_hist#>>'{admission,resource_scope}' IN('world','staff_simulation'))) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF ((v_w.kind='director' AND v_w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/4')
 OR(v_w.kind='narration'AND v_w.payload->>'schema_version' IN('mission-generic-narration/2','mission-generic-narration/3','mission-generic-narration/4'))
 OR(v_w.kind='choice'AND v_w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-choice/1')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF p_finalized THEN
  IF v_w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed' OR v_w.finalized_at IS NULL OR v_w.receipt_id IS NULL
   OR v_w.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(v_w.result) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 ELSE
  IF v_w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'claimed' OR v_w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL OR v_w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
   OR v_w.result IS NOT NULL OR v_w.result_sha256 IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 IF(SELECT count(*)FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND v_a.event_code='c8_count_started')<>1
 OR(SELECT count(*)FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND v_a.event_code IN('c8_count_unknown','c8_count_success'))<>1
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT details INTO v_start FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit WHERE receipt_id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND event_code='c8_count_started';
 SELECT details INTO v_proof FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit WHERE receipt_id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND event_code IN('c8_count_unknown','c8_count_success');
 v_snapshot:=v_start->'policy_snapshot';
 IF (v_start->>'work_id'=v_w.id::text AND v_start->>'lease_id'=v_w.lease_id::text
  AND v_start->>'measurement_id'=v_proof->>'measurement_id'
  AND v_proof->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-count-proof/1'AND v_proof->>'work_id'=v_w.id::text
  AND v_proof->>'generation_allowed'='false'AND v_proof->>'count_http_calls'='1'AND v_proof->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
  AND v_start->>'generation_request_sha256'=v_proof->>'generation_request_sha256'
  AND v_start->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'=v_proof->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
  AND public.combat_v2_sha256(v_snapshot)=v_proof->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
  AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_start->>'generation_request_text','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=v_proof->>'generation_request_sha256'
  AND v_start->>'execution_context'=v_hist->>'execution_context'
  AND v_start->>'admission_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(v_hist->'admission')
  AND v_start->>'c7_budget_qualification_sha256'=v_hist->>'c7_budget_qualification_sha256'
  AND v_start->>'count_qualification_sha256'=v_hist->>'financial_qualification_sha256'
  AND v_start->>'shared_count_scope'=v_w.master_session_id::text AND v_start->>'shared_count_source'=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id::text
  AND v_start->>'shared_count_call_no'='2'
  AND public.combat_v2_sha256(v_start->'count_projection')=v_start->>'count_request_sha256'
  AND v_snapshot->>'model'='gpt-6-luna'AND v_snapshot->>'reasoning_effort'='high'AND v_snapshot->'store'='false'::jsonb
  AND v_snapshot->'input_usd_million'='0.1'::jsonb AND v_snapshot->'output_usd_million'='0.5'::jsonb
  AND ((v_start->>'provider_input_contract_version'='mission-generic-provider-input/6'
   AND v_hist->>'execution_context'='staff_mission'AND v_snapshot->>'schema_version'='c1266-staff-scene-count-snapshot/2'
   AND v_snapshot->>'release_sha256'=v_hist->>'release_sha256'
   AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(v_snapshot,ARRAY['policy_version','model','reasoning_effort','store','max_input_tokens','max_output_tokens','input_usd_million','output_usd_million','schema_version','scene_policy','scene_policy_sha256','scene_policy_contract_sha256','release_sha256','backing_origin'])
   AND v_snapshot->'scene_policy'='{"mode":"staff_scene_uncapped","maxCount":null,"maxGen":null,"maxHTTP":null,"maxUSD":null}'::jsonb
   AND v_snapshot->>'scene_policy_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(v_snapshot->'scene_policy')
   AND v_snapshot->>'scene_policy_contract_sha256'='1564720ca33bc961ff26fc15e07bd364ebd41a60b7a5a48c970a9c100038fad6')
  OR(v_start->>'provider_input_contract_version'='mission-generic-provider-input/5'
   AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(v_snapshot,ARRAY['policy_version','model','reasoning_effort','store','max_input_tokens','max_output_tokens','input_usd_million','output_usd_million'])))
  AND v_snapshot->>'max_input_tokens'='24000'AND v_snapshot->>'max_output_tokens'='20000'
  AND v_snapshot->>'max_input_tokens'=v_proof->>'max_input_tokens'
  AND v_start->>'shared_count_ticket'~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  AND v_start->>'count_upper_cost_usd'~'^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF v_proof->>'state'='unknown'AND jsonb_typeof(v_proof->'input_tokens')='null' THEN v_kind:='MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_UNKNOWN';
 ELSIF v_proof->>'state'='success'AND(v_proof->>'input_tokens'~'^[0-9]+$')IS TRUE THEN
  IF(v_proof->>'input_tokens')::numeric<=(v_snapshot->>'max_input_tokens')::numeric THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  v_kind:='MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW';
 ELSE RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO v_d FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=v_w.dispatch_receipt_id;
 IF(v_d.master_session_id=v_w.master_session_id AND v_d.authority_receipt_id=v_w.id AND v_d.request_key=v_w.request_key
  AND v_d.event_kind='mission_generic_event'AND v_d.renderer_version='mission-generic-runtime/1'
  AND v_d.envelope->>'payload_sha256'=v_w.payload_sha256 AND v_d.dispatch_count=0 AND v_d.charged_cost_usd=0
  AND v_d.upper_bound_cost_usd IS NULL AND v_d.lease_token_sha256 IS NULL AND v_d.lease_expires_at IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_d.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_d.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls v_a WHERE v_a.source_id=v_d.id AND v_a.scope_id=v_w.master_session_id AND v_a.call_no=1))IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF p_finalized THEN
  IF v_d.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'OR v_d.finalized_at IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 ELSE IF v_d.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'claimed'OR v_d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;END IF;
 IF v_w.kind='director'AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows v_window
  WHERE v_window.id=v_w.authority_receipt_id AND v_window.work_id=v_w.id AND v_window.master_session_id=v_w.master_session_id
   AND v_window.source_sha256=v_w.payload_sha256 AND v_window.definition_sha256=v_w.definition_sha256
   AND v_window.step_key=v_w.step_key AND v_window.run_control_version=v_w.run_control_version
   AND v_window.consumed_message_id IS NULL AND v_window.superseded_at IS NULL)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- Effects of THIS work only: past public Fati and a sealed ready writer batch are preserved.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches v_b WHERE v_b.decision_work_id=v_w.id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 v_p WHERE v_p.work_id=v_w.id) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF v_w.kind='narration'AND v_w.payload->>'mode'='unified' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches v_b WHERE v_b.id=v_w.authority_receipt_id
   AND v_b.writer_work_id=v_w.id AND v_b.master_session_id=v_w.master_session_id AND v_b.state='ready'AND v_b.message_id IS NULL
   AND v_b.payload=v_w.payload AND v_b.payload_sha256=v_w.payload_sha256
   AND v_b.decision_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(v_b.decision)
   AND v_w.payload->>'batch_id'=v_b.id::text AND v_w.payload->>'preparation_receipt_id'=v_b.id::text
   AND v_w.payload->>'next_state_receipt_id'=v_b.id::text AND v_w.payload#>>'{publication_barrier,closed}'='true'
   AND v_w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,required_receipt_ids}'=v_w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,receipt_ids}'
   AND v_w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,receipt_ids}'@>jsonb_build_array(v_b.id)
   AND v_b.step_key=v_w.step_key AND v_b.run_control_version=v_w.run_control_version
   AND ((v_b.decision->>'schema_version'='mission-director-proposal/4'
    AND v_w.payload->'director_proposal'=v_b.decision-'role_disposition'
    AND v_w.payload->'role_disposition'=v_b.decision->'role_disposition'
    AND v_w.payload->'role_interpretation'=v_b.decision->'role_interpretation')
    OR(v_b.decision->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-director-proposal/4'AND v_w.payload->'director_proposal'=v_b.decision)))
  THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 v_ticket:=(v_start->>'shared_count_ticket')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO v_c FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls WHERE id=v_ticket;
 IF(v_c.producer='mission_generic_ai'AND v_c.scope_id=v_w.master_session_id AND v_c.source_id=v_d.id AND v_c.call_no=2
  AND v_c.state='unknown_billable'AND v_c.charged_usd IS NULL AND v_c.reserved_usd=0.0124
  AND v_c.reserved_usd=(v_start->>'count_upper_cost_usd')::numeric AND v_c.model=v_snapshot->>'model') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF p_finalized THEN
  IF(SELECT count(*)FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit v_a WHERE v_a.receipt_id=v_d.id AND v_a.event_code='c1266_count_terminal')<>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  SELECT details INTO v_terminal FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit WHERE receipt_id=v_d.id AND event_code='c1266_count_terminal';
  IF(v_terminal->>'schema_version'='c1266-count-terminal-audit/1'AND v_terminal->>'work_id'=v_w.id::text
   AND v_terminal->>'receipt_id'=v_w.receipt_id::text AND v_terminal->>'result_sha256'=v_w.result_sha256
   AND v_terminal->>'payload_sha256'=v_w.payload_sha256 AND v_terminal->>'measurement_id'=v_proof->>'measurement_id'
   AND v_terminal->>'generation_request_sha256'=v_proof->>'generation_request_sha256'
   AND v_terminal->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'=v_proof->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'AND v_terminal->>'count_ticket'=v_ticket::text
   AND v_terminal->>'count_ticket_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(v_c))
   AND v_w.result->>'schema_version'='c1266-count-terminal-failure/1'AND v_w.result->>'failure_code'=v_kind
   AND v_w.result->'failure_codes'=jsonb_build_array(v_kind)
   AND v_w.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'AND v_w.result->>'count_http_calls'='1'AND v_w.result->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
   AND v_w.result->>'count_cost_state'='unknown_billable'AND v_w.result->'count_reserve_usd'=to_jsonb(v_c.reserved_usd)) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','c1266-count-terminal-proof/1','work_id',v_w.id,'master_session_id',v_w.master_session_id,
  'event_id',v_w.event_id,'request_key',v_w.request_key,'revision',v_w.revision,'dispatch_receipt_id',v_d.id,
  'measurement_id',v_proof->>'measurement_id','generation_request_sha256',v_proof->>'generation_request_sha256',
  'policy_snapshot_sha256',v_proof->>'policy_snapshot_sha256','release_sha256',v_hist->>'release_sha256','failure_code',v_kind,
  'count_ticket',v_ticket,'count_ticket_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(v_c)),
  'input_tokens',v_proof->'input_tokens','max_input_tokens',v_snapshot->'max_input_tokens');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.count_overflow_terminal_v1(p_work uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE negative_state text;w mission_generic_owner.work_items;d mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;st jsonb;pr jsonb;c staff_ai_quota_private.calls;res jsonb;out_receipt uuid;expected_input integer:=12000;expected_reserve numeric:=0.0112;c26_hist jsonb;c26_permanent jsonb;c26_count_before text;c20_owned boolean;c20_proof jsonb;c21_owned boolean;c21_session uuid;
BEGIN
 PERFORM mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
 -- No terminal Count operation is possible for an unclaimed ready/completed work.
 SELECT state INTO negative_state FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 IF FOUND AND negative_state NOT IN('claimed','failed') THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT master_session_id INTO c21_session FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 c21_owned:=(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 sticky_wc
 WHERE sticky_wc.master_session_id=c21_session AND sticky_wc.scope='staff_mission'
 AND sticky_wc.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(sticky_wc.contract)
 AND sticky_wc.contract->>'schema_version'='mission-narrative-admission/3'
 AND sticky_wc.contract->'features' ? 'execution_authority_v1'
 AND (sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,schema_version}'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/1' OR ((mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/2') AND sticky_wc.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority}'=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)))
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,execution_context}'='staff_mission'
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission,kind}'='staff_finite'
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission,resource_scope}'='staff_simulation'
 AND (sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,source_scope,mission_id}'='5878822d-dc03-4ac2-ad0b-1547f0ab3fc0' OR ((mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/2') AND sticky_wc.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority}'=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)))
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,release_sha256}'=sticky_wc.release_sha256
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,binding_sha256}'=sticky_wc.definition_sha256) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources ss21
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs21 ON bs21.request_key=ss21.request_key
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.start_claims sc22 ON sc22.session_id=bs21.master_session_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.run_bindings rb21 ON rb21.master_session_id=bs21.master_session_id
 JOIN public.master_v2_sessions ms21 ON ms21.id=bs21.master_session_id
  AND ms21.mission_id=ss21.carrier_mission_id
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 manual_source WHERE manual_source.master_session_id=bs21.master_session_id) AND bs21.master_session_id=c21_session
 AND ms21.owner_kind='ai_service' AND ms21.master_user IS NULL
 AND ms21.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
 AND (ss21.source_mission_id='5878822d-dc03-4ac2-ad0b-1547f0ab3fc0'::uuid OR (mission_generic_owner.c1266_staff_source_scope_v1(bs21.master_session_id) IS NOT NULL AND ss21.source_mission_id::text=mission_generic_owner.c1266_staff_source_scope_v1(bs21.master_session_id)#>>'{source_scope,mission_id}'))
 AND sc22.state='bound' AND sc22.simulation
 AND sc22.mission_id=ms21.mission_id AND sc22.location_id=ms21.location_id
 AND sc22.request_key=bs21.request_key
 AND bs21.simulation AND bs21.snapshot->'simulation'='true'::jsonb
 AND bs21.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(bs21.snapshot)
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-opening-source/1'
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'mission_id'=ss21.carrier_mission_id::text
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'location_id'='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'
 AND rb21.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(rb21.snapshot)
 AND rb21.snapshot->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-run/1'));
 IF c21_owned THEN
  PERFORM mission_generic_owner.dispatch_user(c21_session,p_user);
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(pg_catalog.hashtextextended('C1266:GENERIC-AI:AVAILABILITY',0));
  PERFORM 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors WHERE master_session_id=c21_session FOR UPDATE;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=c21_session FOR UPDATE;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work FOR UPDATE;
 IF c21_owned IS DISTINCT FROM (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 sticky_wc
 WHERE sticky_wc.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND sticky_wc.scope='staff_mission'
 AND sticky_wc.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(sticky_wc.contract)
 AND sticky_wc.contract->>'schema_version'='mission-narrative-admission/3'
 AND sticky_wc.contract->'features' ? 'execution_authority_v1'
 AND (sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,schema_version}'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/1' OR ((mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/2') AND sticky_wc.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority}'=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)))
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,execution_context}'='staff_mission'
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission,kind}'='staff_finite'
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission,resource_scope}'='staff_simulation'
 AND (sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,source_scope,mission_id}'='5878822d-dc03-4ac2-ad0b-1547f0ab3fc0' OR ((mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/2') AND sticky_wc.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority}'=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)))
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,release_sha256}'=sticky_wc.release_sha256
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,binding_sha256}'=sticky_wc.definition_sha256) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources ss21
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs21 ON bs21.request_key=ss21.request_key
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.start_claims sc22 ON sc22.session_id=bs21.master_session_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.run_bindings rb21 ON rb21.master_session_id=bs21.master_session_id
 JOIN public.master_v2_sessions ms21 ON ms21.id=bs21.master_session_id
  AND ms21.mission_id=ss21.carrier_mission_id
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 manual_source WHERE manual_source.master_session_id=bs21.master_session_id) AND bs21.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
 AND ms21.owner_kind='ai_service' AND ms21.master_user IS NULL
 AND ms21.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
 AND (ss21.source_mission_id='5878822d-dc03-4ac2-ad0b-1547f0ab3fc0'::uuid OR (mission_generic_owner.c1266_staff_source_scope_v1(bs21.master_session_id) IS NOT NULL AND ss21.source_mission_id::text=mission_generic_owner.c1266_staff_source_scope_v1(bs21.master_session_id)#>>'{source_scope,mission_id}'))
 AND sc22.state='bound' AND sc22.simulation
 AND sc22.mission_id=ms21.mission_id AND sc22.location_id=ms21.location_id
 AND sc22.request_key=bs21.request_key
 AND bs21.simulation AND bs21.snapshot->'simulation'='true'::jsonb
 AND bs21.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(bs21.snapshot)
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-opening-source/1'
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'mission_id'=ss21.carrier_mission_id::text
 AND bs21.snapshot->>'location_id'='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'
 AND rb21.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(rb21.snapshot)
 AND rb21.snapshot->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-run/1')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_LOCK_SCOPE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 c20_owned:=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 sticky_wc
 WHERE sticky_wc.work_id=w.id AND sticky_wc.scope='staff_mission'
 AND sticky_wc.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(sticky_wc.contract)
 AND sticky_wc.contract->>'schema_version'='mission-narrative-admission/3'
 AND sticky_wc.contract->'features' ? 'execution_authority_v1'
 AND (sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,schema_version}'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/1' OR ((mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/2') AND sticky_wc.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority}'=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)))
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,execution_context}'='staff_mission'
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission,kind}'='staff_finite'
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission,resource_scope}'='staff_simulation'
 AND (sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,source_scope,mission_id}'='5878822d-dc03-4ac2-ad0b-1547f0ab3fc0' OR ((mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/2') AND sticky_wc.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority}'=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(sticky_wc.work_id)))
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,release_sha256}'=sticky_wc.release_sha256
 AND sticky_wc.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,binding_sha256}'=sticky_wc.definition_sha256);
 IF c20_owned THEN PERFORM mission_generic_owner.dispatch_user(w.master_session_id,p_user);END IF;
 -- Exact protected cleanup sibling. No current availability/clock is a provider permission here.
 IF w.id='d8b37311-6010-4a07-95d3-5e65a33c756d'::uuid
 AND w.master_session_id='9ac00210-4c88-4c0c-a443-95e3d6740a28'::uuid THEN
  PERFORM mission_generic_owner.dispatch_user(w.master_session_id,p_user);
  c26_hist:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id);
  IF (w.kind='director' AND w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/4'
   AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
   AND c26_hist->>'execution_context'='staff_mission'
   AND c26_hist#>>'{admission,kind}'='staff_finite'
   AND c26_hist#>>'{admission,resource_scope}'='staff_simulation'
   AND c26_hist#>>'{admission,location_id}'='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'
   AND p_user IN('f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles cleanup_profile WHERE cleanup_profile.id=p_user AND cleanup_profile.role IN('admin','master'))
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions cleanup_master JOIN public.locations cleanup_location ON cleanup_location.id=cleanup_master.location_id
    WHERE cleanup_master.id=w.master_session_id AND cleanup_master.owner_kind='ai_service'AND cleanup_master.closed_at IS NULL
    AND cleanup_master.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'AND cleanup_location.is_test AND cleanup_location.is_active)) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
  THEN RETURN false;END IF;
  IF w.state='failed' AND w.result->>'schema_version'='mission-input-count-unknown-failure/1'
   AND w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cleanup_done
    WHERE cleanup_done.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND cleanup_done.event_code='generic_count_unknown_terminal'
    AND cleanup_done.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND cleanup_done.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text
    AND cleanup_done.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256) THEN RETURN true;END IF;
  IF w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'claimed' OR w.lease_id IS NULL OR w.lease_expires_at IS NULL
   OR w.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() OR w.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR w.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL
   OR w.result IS NOT NULL OR w.result_sha256 IS NOT NULL OR w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL OR w.message_id IS NOT NULL
   OR w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;
  SELECT cleanup_start.details INTO st FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cleanup_start
   WHERE cleanup_start.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND cleanup_start.event_code='c8_count_started';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
  SELECT cleanup_proof.details INTO pr FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cleanup_proof
   WHERE cleanup_proof.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND cleanup_proof.event_code='c8_count_unknown';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=w.dispatch_receipt_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF (st->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND st->>'lease_id'=w.lease_id::text
   AND st->>'measurement_id'=pr->>'measurement_id' AND pr->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-count-proof/1'
   AND pr->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND pr->>'state'='unknown'AND jsonb_typeof(pr->'input_tokens')='null'
   AND pr->>'max_input_tokens'='24000'AND pr->>'generation_allowed'='false'
   AND pr->>'count_http_calls'='1'AND pr->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
   AND pr->>'generation_request_sha256'=st->>'generation_request_sha256'
   AND pr->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'=st->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
   AND st#>>'{policy_snapshot,max_input_tokens}'='24000'AND st#>>'{policy_snapshot,max_output_tokens}'='20000'
   AND st#>>'{policy_snapshot,release_sha256}'=c26_hist->>'release_sha256'
   AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(st->>'generation_request_text','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=st->>'generation_request_sha256'
   AND public.combat_v2_sha256(st->'policy_snapshot')=st->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
   AND d.id='9d402d86-41c5-4c8a-9194-b603d928e1b5'AND d.status='claimed'AND d.finalized_at IS NULL
   AND d.dispatch_count=0 AND d.charged_cost_usd=0 AND d.upper_bound_cost_usd IS NULL
   AND d.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND d.authority_receipt_id=w.id AND d.request_key=w.request_key
   AND d.event_kind='mission_generic_event'AND d.renderer_version='mission-generic-runtime/1'
   AND d.envelope->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256 AND d.lease_token_sha256 IS NULL AND d.lease_expires_at IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts cleanup_attempt WHERE cleanup_attempt.receipt_id=d.id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations cleanup_authorization WHERE cleanup_authorization.receipt_id=d.id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls cleanup_gen WHERE cleanup_gen.source_id=d.id AND cleanup_gen.scope_id=w.master_session_id AND cleanup_gen.call_no=1)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches cleanup_batch WHERE cleanup_batch.master_session_id=w.master_session_id)) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_COUNT_UNKNOWN_TERMINAL_BINDING' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls WHERE id=(st->>'shared_count_ticket')::uuid FOR UPDATE;
  IF c.producer IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission_generic_ai'OR c.scope_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id
   OR c.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.id OR c.call_no IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR c.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'unknown_billable'
   OR c.charged_usd IS NOT NULL OR c.reserved_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0.0124
   OR c.reserved_usd IS DISTINCT FROM (st->>'count_upper_cost_usd')::numeric
   OR c.model IS DISTINCT FROM st#>>'{policy_snapshot,model}'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_COUNT_UNKNOWN_TICKET_BINDING' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
  c26_count_before:=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(c));
  out_receipt:=gen_random_uuid();
  res:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-input-count-unknown-failure/1','work_id',w.id,'master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
   'ok',false,'failure_code','MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_UNKNOWN','failure_codes',jsonb_build_array('MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_UNKNOWN'),
   'outcome_uncertain',false,'count_outcome_unknown',true,'provider_calls',0,'provider_http_calls_total',1,
   'generation_http_calls',0,'generation_charged_cost_usd',0,'count_http_calls',1,
   'count_cost_state','unknown_billable','count_reserve_usd',c.reserved_usd,
   'measurement_id',pr->>'measurement_id','input_tokens',NULL,'max_input_tokens',24000);
  UPDATE mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts SET status='failed',finalized_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp()WHERE id=d.id;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.work_items SET state='failed',result=res,result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(res),receipt_id=out_receipt,finalized_at=clock_timestamp()WHERE id=w.id;
  INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit(receipt_id,event_code,details)VALUES(d.id,'generic_count_unknown_terminal',jsonb_build_object(
   'schema_version','c1266-count-unknown-terminal/1','work_id',w.id,'receipt_id',out_receipt,'source_window_id',w.authority_receipt_id,

  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_COUNT_UNKNOWN_ACCOUNTING_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;

 END IF;
 -- Permanent C1266 sibling: immutable Count proof, no new lease/Count/Gen.
 c20_proof:=CASE WHEN c20_owned THEN mission_generic_owner.c1266_count_terminal_proof_v1(w.id,w.state='failed') ELSE NULL END;
 c26_permanent:=CASE WHEN c20_owned THEN CASE WHEN c20_proof IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ((c20_proof)-'count_ticket'-'count_ticket_sha256'-'input_tokens'-'max_input_tokens')||jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-count-reconciliation/1','operation','status_only') END ELSE mission_generic_owner.c1266_count_reconciliation_v1(w.id,p_user,w.state='failed') END;
 IF c26_permanent IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF w.state='failed' THEN RETURN true;END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=w.dispatch_receipt_id FOR UPDATE;

  c26_count_before:=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(c));out_receipt:=gen_random_uuid();

   'ok',false,'failure_code',pr->>'failure_code','failure_codes',jsonb_build_array(pr->>'failure_code'),
   'outcome_uncertain',false,'count_outcome_unknown',pr->>'failure_code'='MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_UNKNOWN',
   'provider_calls',0,'provider_http_calls_total',1,'generation_http_calls',0,'generation_charged_cost_usd',0,
   'count_http_calls',1,'count_cost_state','unknown_billable','count_reserve_usd',c.reserved_usd,
   'measurement_id',pr->>'measurement_id','input_tokens',pr->'input_tokens','max_input_tokens',pr->'max_input_tokens');
  UPDATE mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts SET status='failed',finalized_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp()WHERE id=d.id;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.work_items SET state='failed',result=res,result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(res),receipt_id=out_receipt,finalized_at=clock_timestamp()WHERE id=w.id;
  INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit(receipt_id,event_code,details)VALUES(d.id,'c1266_count_terminal',jsonb_build_object(
   'schema_version','c1266-count-terminal-audit/1','work_id',w.id,'receipt_id',out_receipt,'payload_sha256',w.payload_sha256,

   'count_ticket',c.id,'count_ticket_sha256',c26_count_before,'count_reserve_usd',c.reserved_usd,'count_http_calls',1,'generation_http_calls',0));
  IF(SELECT public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(c26_ticket))FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls c26_ticket WHERE c26_ticket.id=c.id)IS DISTINCT FROM c26_count_before
   OR mission_generic_owner.c1266_count_terminal_proof_v1(w.id,true)IS NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_COUNT_TERMINAL_FINAL_PROOF' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
  RETURN true;
 END IF;
 IF w.master_session_id<>'ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid OR w.kind NOT IN('director','narration') THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 PERFORM mission_generic_owner.dispatch_user(w.master_session_id,p_user);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=p_user AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
 OR p_user NOT IN('f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m WHERE m.id=w.master_session_id AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND m.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND m.closed_at IS NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources WHERE session_id=w.master_session_id)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.run_bindings rb WHERE rb.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND rb.snapshot_sha256='49817335c60ce9d4b47bc5d81c6950f622635c7fb232264ab54736349124f567' AND rb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(rb.snapshot)) THEN RETURN false;END IF;

 IF w.kind='narration' AND NOT (EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows s ON s.id=b.source_window_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items parent ON parent.id=b.decision_work_id
 WHERE b.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND b.writer_work_id=w.id AND b.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
 AND b.state='ready' AND b.message_id IS NULL AND b.payload=w.payload AND b.payload_sha256=w.payload_sha256
 AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload) AND w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/4'
 AND w.payload->>'mode'='unified' AND w.payload#>>'{publication_barrier,closed}'='true'

 AND w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,receipt_ids}' @> jsonb_build_array(b.id)
 AND w.payload->>'preparation_receipt_id'=b.id::text
 AND w.payload->'director_proposal'=b.decision AND b.decision_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(b.decision)
 AND s.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND s.work_id=parent.id
 AND s.superseded_at IS NULL AND s.consumed_message_id IS NULL
 AND parent.kind='director' AND parent.state='completed' AND parent.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
 AND parent.result->>'ok'='true' AND parent.result->'decision'=b.decision
 AND parent.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(parent.payload)
 AND s.source_sha256=parent.payload_sha256 AND s.definition_sha256=w.definition_sha256
 AND b.step_key=w.step_key AND b.run_control_version=w.run_control_version
 AND w.message_id IS NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 pub WHERE pub.work_id=w.id)
 ) OR  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b
 WHERE b.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND b.id='32e674f6-f1b8-4273-973e-7da88ed2c5b9'::uuid
 AND b.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND b.writer_work_id=w.id AND b.state='ready' AND b.message_id IS NULL
 AND b.composition_kind='combat_resolved_no_pending' AND b.source_window_id IS NULL AND b.next_round_id IS NULL
 AND b.encounter_id='28af57fd-aaea-4036-8881-e3df39e23092'::uuid AND b.run_control_version=4
 AND b.source_report_id='5b5f46db-c1e2-4ad6-b0f1-dc9563e81eb0'::uuid AND b.secondary_report_id='a5355e32-d780-490d-97fa-2767af05db7f'::uuid
 AND b.source_round_id='f7e9fdaf-8681-4034-ab96-3e668a176956'::uuid
 AND b.payload=w.payload AND b.payload_sha256=w.payload_sha256 AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 AND w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/3' AND w.payload->>'mode'='unified'
 AND w.payload->>'composition_kind'=b.composition_kind AND w.payload->>'batch_id'=b.id::text
 AND w.payload->>'preparation_receipt_id'=b.id::text AND w.payload->>'next_state_receipt_id'=b.id::text
 AND w.payload->'publication_barrier'=jsonb_build_object('closed',true,'required_receipt_ids',jsonb_build_array(b.id,b.source_report_id,b.secondary_report_id),'receipt_ids',jsonb_build_array(b.id,b.source_report_id,b.secondary_report_id))
 AND public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload#>'{resolved_scenes,0}')='8ffc1e7abc84f8db7da30e3af234ab6e574106464cb760fa4204891291af3f53' AND public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload#>'{resolved_scenes,1}')='37de1843c7c1967d25a564e2cd682bc2e4baae20d996aac647365529e0ae06bb' AND jsonb_array_length(w.payload->'resolved_scenes')=2 AND w.payload->'pending_offensives'='[]'::jsonb AND w.payload->'source_windows'='[]'::jsonb
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.payload->'resolved_scenes') item
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports rp JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds cr ON cr.id=rp.round_id
 WHERE rp.id=CASE WHEN (item#>>'{scene_binding,report_sha256}')=(SELECT mechanics_sha256 FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports WHERE id=b.source_report_id) THEN b.source_report_id ELSE b.secondary_report_id END
 AND item->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/2' AND item->>'mode'='combat'
 AND item#>>'{scene_binding,session_id}'=b.encounter_id::text AND item#>>'{scene_binding,control_version}'=b.run_control_version::text
 AND item#>>'{scene_binding,round_id}'=cr.id::text AND item#>>'{scene_binding,report_sha256}'=rp.mechanics_sha256
 AND item#>>'{scene,snapshot_sha256}'=public.combat_v2_sha256(item#>'{scene,snapshot}')
 AND item#>>'{scene_binding,scene_sha256}'=item#>>'{scene,snapshot_sha256}'
 AND item->'barrier'=jsonb_build_object('closed',true,'required_receipt_ids',jsonb_build_array(rp.id),'receipt_ids',jsonb_build_array(rp.id))
 AND cr.session_id=b.encounter_id AND cr.report_id=rp.id AND cr.state='risolto' AND cr.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
 AND rp.narration_state='attesa' AND rp.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(rp.mechanics) AND rp.values_written IS FALSE))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_report_publications pub WHERE pub.report_id IN(b.source_report_id,b.secondary_report_id))
 AND public.combat_v2_values_written(b.encounter_id) IS FALSE AND combat_panel_private.uses_simulated_pools(b.encounter_id) IS TRUE
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.mission_run_state r WHERE r.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND r.run_phase='in_corso' AND r.current_step_key=b.step_key AND r.control_version=b.run_control_version)
 )) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF w.state='failed' AND w.result->>'schema_version'='mission-count-overflow-failure/1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='generic_count_overflow_terminal' AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256) THEN RETURN true;END IF;
 IF w.state<>'claimed' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF w.id='48e1bdcd-f044-be8c-1923-54d38e7e822c'::uuid AND mission_generic_owner.c8_context24_scope_v1(w.id) THEN expected_input:=24000;expected_reserve:=0.0124;END IF;
 SELECT a.details INTO st FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_started';IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT a.details INTO pr FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_success';IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF pr->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'success' OR pr->>'generation_allowed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=w.dispatch_receipt_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF st->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.id::text OR st->>'lease_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.lease_id::text
 OR st->>'measurement_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pr->>'measurement_id'
 OR pr->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-count-proof/1' OR pr->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.id::text
 OR pr->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'success' OR pr->>'generation_allowed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'
 OR pr->>'count_http_calls' IS DISTINCT FROM '1' OR pr->>'generation_http_calls' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'
 OR (pr->>'input_tokens' ~ '^[0-9]+$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE OR pr->>'max_input_tokens' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_input::text
 OR (pr->>'input_tokens')::numeric<=(pr->>'max_input_tokens')::numeric
 OR pr->>'generation_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM st->>'generation_request_sha256'
 OR pr->>'policy_snapshot_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM st->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
 OR st#>>'{policy_snapshot,max_input_tokens}' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_input::text
 OR encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(st->>'generation_request_text','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM st->>'generation_request_sha256'

 OR w.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR w.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL
 OR d.status<>'claimed' OR d.dispatch_count<>0 OR d.charged_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR d.upper_bound_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
 OR d.master_session_id<>w.master_session_id OR d.authority_receipt_id<>w.id OR d.request_key<>w.request_key
 OR d.event_kind<>'mission_generic_event' OR d.renderer_version<>'mission-generic-runtime/1'
 OR d.envelope->>'payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload_sha256
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts a WHERE a.receipt_id=d.id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations a WHERE a.receipt_id=d.id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls a WHERE a.source_id=d.id AND a.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND a.call_no=1)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_COUNT_OVERFLOW_BINDING' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls WHERE id=(st->>'shared_count_ticket')::uuid FOR UPDATE;
 IF c.producer IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission_generic_ai' OR c.scope_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id OR c.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.id
 OR c.call_no IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR c.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'unknown_billable' OR c.charged_usd IS NOT NULL
 OR c.reserved_usd IS DISTINCT FROM (st->>'count_upper_cost_usd')::numeric OR c.reserved_usd IS DISTINCT FROM expected_reserve
 OR c.model IS DISTINCT FROM st#>>'{policy_snapshot,model}' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1264_COUNT_SHARED_BINDING' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 out_receipt:=gen_random_uuid();res:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-count-overflow-failure/1','work_id',w.id,'master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'ok',false,'failure_code','MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW','failure_codes',jsonb_build_array('MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW'),'outcome_uncertain',false,'provider_calls',0,'generation_http_calls',0,'generation_charged_cost_usd',0,'count_http_calls',1,'count_cost_state','unknown_billable','count_reserve_usd',c.reserved_usd,'measurement_id',pr->>'measurement_id','input_tokens',(pr->>'input_tokens')::integer,'max_input_tokens',expected_input);
 UPDATE mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts SET status='failed',finalized_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=d.id;
 UPDATE mission_generic_owner.work_items SET state='failed',result=res,result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(res),receipt_id=out_receipt,finalized_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=w.id;
 INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit(receipt_id,event_code,details) VALUES(d.id,'generic_count_overflow_terminal',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','c1264-count-overflow-terminal/1','work_id',w.id,'receipt_id',out_receipt,'source_window_id',w.authority_receipt_id,'payload_sha256',w.payload_sha256,'measurement_id',pr->>'measurement_id','generation_request_sha256',pr->>'generation_request_sha256','result_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(res),'count_ticket',c.id,'count_reserve_usd',c.reserved_usd,'generation_http_calls',0));
